items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。我们提出一种残差学习框架，以缓解比以往所用网络深得多的网络的训练难度。我们明确地将层重新表述为学习相对于层输入的残差函数，而不是学习无参照的函数。我们提供全面的经验证据，表明这些残差网络更容易优化，并且能够从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升。在ImageNet数据集上，我们评估了深度达152层的残差网络——比VGG网络深8倍，但复杂度仍更低。这些残差网络的集成在ImageNet测试集上取得3.57%的错误率。该结果在ILSVRC 2015分类任务中获得第1名。我们还对具有100层和1000层的CIFAR-10进行了分析。表示的深度对于许多视觉识别任务至关重要。仅由于我们极深的表示，我们在COCO目标检测数据集上获得了28%的相对改进。深度残差网络是我们提交至ILSVRC和COCO 2015竞赛的基础，我们还在ImageNet检测、ImageNet定位、COCO检测和COCO分割任务中获得第1名。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。本文提出一种残差学习框架，用以减轻远深于以往网络的训练难度。我们把网络层显式地重新表述为学习相对于层输入的残差函数，而非学习无参考的函数。大量实验表明，残差网络更易优化，并能从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升。在 ImageNet 数据集上，我们评估了深达 152 层的残差网络——比 VGG 深 8 倍但复杂度更低。这些残差网络的集成在 ImageNet 测试集上取得 3.57% 的错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名。我们还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层与 1000 层的网络。表征深度对许多视觉识别任务至关重要：仅因极深的表征，我们在 COCO 目标检测数据集上获得 28% 的相对提升。深度残差网络是我们参加 ILSVRC 与 COCO 2015 竞赛的基础，并在 ImageNet 检测、ImageNet 定位、COCO 检测与 COCO 分割任务中均获第一名。
items.highlight_zh: 残差连接让152层网络更易训练并刷新多项视觉竞赛纪录
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：神经网络层数越深理论上表达力越强，但实践中深层网络会出现退化问题——训练误差反而上升，且难以优化。
2. 方法：作者提出「残差学习」。传统网络层直接学习目标映射 H(x)，而残差网络让若干层去学习残差 F(x)=H(x)-x，再通过一条「捷径连接」把输入 x 直接加到输出上，使该层只需学习「相对输入的改动」。这样梯度可以沿捷径更顺畅地回传，深层网络因此更易训练；当某层无需改动时，只需把残差学成零即可，优化更简单。
3. 结果：在 ImageNet 上训练了最深 152 层的残差网络，深度是 VGG 的 8 倍而计算复杂度更低；多个残差网络集成后在测试集上错误率仅 3.57%，夺得 ILSVRC 2015 分类冠军，并在检测、定位及 COCO 检测、分割任务中均列第一。在 CIFAR-10 上还验证了 100 层乃至 1000 层网络的可行性。
4. 意义：论文表明「深度」本身对视觉识别至关重要，仅凭更强的深层特征，COCO 检测就取得 28% 的相对提升。残差连接此后成为深度学习的基础组件，几乎被所有现代网络架构采用。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 用 AlphaFold 实现高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于从机制上理解其功能。经过大量实验努力，约 10 万种独特蛋白质的结构已被测定，但这只是已知数十亿条蛋白质序列中的一小部分。测定单个蛋白质结构往往需要数月乃至数年的艰苦工作，成为结构覆盖的瓶颈，因此亟需准确的计算方法来填补这一空白并支撑大规模结构生物信息学。仅凭氨基酸序列预测蛋白质将采纳的三维结构——即「蛋白质折叠问题」中的结构预测部分——是 50 多年来重要的开放研究难题。尽管近期有进展，现有方法仍远未达到原子级精度，在缺乏同源结构时尤其如此。本文给出首个即使在无相似结构可知的情况下，也能常规地以原子精度预测蛋白质结构的计算方法。我们在颇具挑战性的第 14 届蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP14）中验证了完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold，多数情况下精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅优于其他方法。最新版 AlphaFold 的核心是一种新颖的机器学习方法，它把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识，通过多序列比对，融入深度学习算法的设计中。
items.highlight_zh: AlphaFold在CASP14实现接近实验精度的原子级蛋白质结构预测
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：蛋白质的三维结构决定其功能，但实验测定（如冷冻电镜、X 射线晶体学）极其耗时，已知序列有数十亿条，而已解析结构仅约 10 万种。仅从氨基酸序列预测结构的「蛋白质折叠问题」已悬而未决 50 多年，现有计算方法在缺少同源模板时精度远达不到原子级。
2. 方法：作者彻底重新设计了基于神经网络的模型 AlphaFold，并把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学先验知识融入网络设计，关键之一是充分利用多序列比对（MSA）信息——同源序列中协同变化的残基暗示了空间接触关系。
3. 结果：在第 14 届 CASP14 盲测评估中，AlphaFold 在大多数目标上的预测精度已可与实验解析结构相竞争，并显著超越所有其他参赛方法，这是首次能在无相似已知结构时也常规达到原子级精度的方法。
4. 意义：该工作被视为结构生物学的重要突破，使大规模、高通量的结构预测与结构生物信息学成为可能，可极大加速对蛋白质功能机制的理解与药物研发等应用。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: 使用衍射深度神经网络的全光学机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光学的衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：在经过基于深度学习的设计后，由多个无源衍射层协同工作，从而学会实现各种功能。我们通过 3D 打印的 D2NN 在太赫兹波段实验演示了该框架的成功——它们学会了实现手写数字分类以及成像透镜的功能。借助现有的丰富 3D 打印与其他光刻制造方法以及空间光调制器，这一全光学深度学习框架能够以光速执行计算机神经网络可实现的多种复杂功能，并将在全光学图像分析、特征检测与目标分类中找到应用，同时催生能够利用 D2NN 学习执行独特任务的新型相机设计与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 用3D打印的无源衍射层构建全光学神经网络，以光速完成分类
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：传统神经网络依赖电子计算机进行大量乘加运算，能耗与时延受硬件限制。能否让「计算」本身由光在传播中完成，从而实现近乎零功耗、光速运行的全光学机器学习？
2. 方法：作者提出衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）。它由若干层无源衍射元件叠成，光穿过每一层时按衍射规律传播与相位调制，相当于网络中的一层「线性变换＋非线性」，而层间参数（每点的相位/振幅）通过基于深度学习的反向传播式训练来设计。设计完成后，网络无需任何外部电源或计算单元，光波通过即完成推理。
3. 结果：团队用 3D 打印制作了工作于太赫兹波段的 D2NN，实验证明它能完成手写数字分类，还能充当成像透镜——说明同一框架可学习实现不同功能。
4. 意义：该工作把神经网络的「计算」迁移到光学物理过程中，为全光学图像分析、特征检测、目标分类以及可学习的新型相机与光学元件提供了新范式，并可与空间光调制器、光刻工艺结合扩展。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：面向语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的语言表示模型 BERT，即基于 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与此前的语言表示模型不同，BERT 在所有层中同时以左右两侧上下文为条件，从无标注文本中预训练深度双向表示。因此，预训练好的 BERT 只需增加一个输出层进行微调，就能在问答、语言推理等广泛任务上得到当前最优模型，而无需对任务相关结构做大幅修改。BERT 概念简单、实证有力，在十一项自然语言处理任务上取得新的最优结果：GLUE 分数提升至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率提升至 86.7%（绝对提升 4.6），SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 提升至 93.2（绝对提升 1.5），SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 提升至 83.1（绝对提升 5.1）。
items.highlight_zh: 双向预训练加一层微调，刷新 11 项 NLP 任务
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】在 BERT 之前，主流语言模型（如 ELMo、GPT）多是单向的：要么从左往右读，要么从右往左读，模型无法同时看到某个词前后的全部上下文，语义理解因而受限。

【用了什么方法】BERT 用多层 Transformer 编码器把文本编码成向量，关键点是在每一层都同时以左右两侧上下文为条件，得到深度双向表示。它先在海量无标注文本上做自监督预训练；下游任务只需在预训练模型上再加一个输出层做微调，不必为每个任务重新设计网络结构。

【有什么结果】作者在十一项自然语言处理任务上刷新最好成绩：GLUE 综合分 80.5%（比之前高 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 推理准确率 86.7%（+4.6），SQuAD v1.1 问答 F1 93.2（+1.5），SQuAD v2.0 F1 83.1（+5.1）。

【为何重要】它把「大规模预训练 + 轻量微调」确立为通用范式：一个骨干模型可迁移到问答、推理等多种任务，大幅降低为每个任务从头训练的成本，并直接影响了此后语言模型的主流做法。论文也强调，方法本身概念简单却有强大实证效果，说明双向上下文与预训练目标本身就是性能提升的关键来源。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：面向视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的高精度开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个能以单目、双目和 RGB-D 相机，并支持针孔与鱼眼镜头模型，实现视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的系统。第一个创新是完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计的、基于特征的紧耦合视觉惯性 SLAM，即使在 IMU 初始化阶段也如此；系统因而能在室内外大小环境中实时鲁棒运行，精度比此前方法高 2 至 5 倍。第二个创新是基于改进召回率场景识别方法的多地图系统：长时间视觉信息贫乏时系统不会失效，丢失跟踪后新建地图，重访已建图区域时再无缝合并。与只用最近数秒信息的视觉里程计不同，ORB-SLAM3 首次在所有算法阶段复用全部历史信息，使时间上相隔久远、但共视的关键帧也能进入光束法平差，提供大视差观测以提升精度。实验显示，在所有传感器配置下其鲁棒性堪比现有最佳系统且明显更准；双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均精度 3.6 cm，在 TUM-VI 快速手持场景下达 9 mm。代码已开源。
items.highlight_zh: 首个统一视觉、视觉惯性与多地图的 SLAM 系统，精度提升 2–5 倍
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】SLAM 让机器人或 AR 设备在未知环境中同时定位与建图。真实系统要面对多种相机（单目、双目、RGB-D，针孔与鱼眼镜头）以及有无 IMU 的差别，还要应付跟踪容易丢失、视觉信息长期不佳的情况。

【用了什么方法】第一，视觉惯性部分采用基于 ORB 特征的紧耦合方案，全程用最大后验（MAP）估计，连 IMU 初始化阶段也不例外，避免初始化与后续估计割裂。第二，多地图机制：借助召回率更高的场景识别，跟踪丢失时新建地图，重访旧区域时再无缝合并。第三，所有阶段复用全部历史信息，把与当前帧共视、但时间上相隔很远甚至来自旧会话的关键帧也纳入 bundle adjustment，用大视差观测提升精度。

【有什么结果】精度比此前方法高 2 至 5 倍；双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均精度 3.6 cm，在 TUM-VI 快速手持场景下达 9 mm（贴近 AR/VR 的典型场景）；各传感器配置下鲁棒性与文献中最佳系统相当。

【为何重要】它是首个同时覆盖视觉、视觉惯性与多地图、并支持多种相机与镜头模型的统一开源系统。始终重用历史信息的设计让长期运行更可靠，开源代码也便于社区复现与落地。

items.title_en: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
items.title_zh: Jeveration：System One 模型现已能够生成
items.abstract_en: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. We therefore condition all positions on a shared random state to coordinate parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Since the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, we first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. Beyond text-to-image generation, we further unify image-to-image generation and dense prediction within the same architecture, so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass. Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.
items.abstract_zh: Jev 等 System One 模型通过快速并行预测给出决策。本文提出 Jeveration，表明同一决策范式也能在单次前向中生成高质量图像。Jeveration 基于一个冻结的视觉-语言模型，将其视觉-语义知识改用于整体图像生成。关键挑战是保持全局一致性：单个提示可对应许多合法图像，而并行预测必须收敛为一个连贯整体。为此，我们用共享随机状态条件化所有位置以协调并行预测，使每次采样得到不同但连贯的图像。由于在直接图像监督下模型容易忽略该状态，我们先学习离散图像码上的分布来引导单次生成。除文生图外，我们还在同一架构中统一了图生图与稠密预测，一个检查点即可支持三项任务、各需一次前向。实验显示，Jeveration 用 78 ms 生成 512×512 图像，比现有统一模型快至 122 倍，同时保持有竞争力的图像质量与稠密预测性能。
items.highlight_zh: 单次前向 78 ms 生成 512×512 图像，快至 122 倍
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】像 Jev 这样的 System One 模型靠一次快速、并行的前向预测给出决策，而不是逐步推理。论文追问：同样的并行预测范式能否不只做判断，还直接生成高质量图像？

【用了什么方法】Jeveration 以一个冻结的视觉-语言模型为基础，把它已有的视觉-语义知识挪作整体图像生成之用。难点在全局一致性：同一段文字提示可以对应很多合理图像，但一次性并行预测所有位置时，结果必须收敛成一个协调的整体。作者用共享随机状态去条件化所有位置的预测，让每次采样得到不同却自洽的图像。又因为直接以图像做监督时模型容易忽略这个随机状态，他们先学习离散图像码上的分布来引导单次生成。此外，同一套架构还统一了文生图、图生图与稠密预测，一个检查点支持三项任务，每项只需一次前向。

【有什么结果】生成一张 512×512 图像仅需 78 ms，比现有统一模型快至 122 倍，图像质量和稠密预测性能仍具竞争力。

【为何重要】它说明一次前向的快速预测不只能承担分类决策，也能承担生成任务，为把生成过程从反复迭代压缩到单步并行提供了可行路径，也让同一个模型同时覆盖理解类任务（稠密预测）与生成成为可能。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: A nonlinear inhibition pathway underlying cortical responses to tuned holographic optogenetic perturbations
items.title_zh: 皮层对调谐全息光遗传扰动的响应背后的非线性抑制通路
items.abstract_en: Optogenetics enables causal manipulation of cortical activity. Theory is essential for predicting network-mediated perturbation responses, which are often counterintuitive. Existing approaches have relied on linear approximations, which can fail for multi-neuron holographic perturbations. We develop a nonlinear theory of responses to such perturbations in networks with cell-type-specific structured connectivity. We apply our theory to mouse V1 data, which shows cotuned-ensemble suppression: perturbing spatially clustered neurons with similar preferred orientations yields stronger short-range suppression than perturbing untuned ensembles. We show that cotuned-ensemble suppression requires a nonlinear inhibition pathway, and predict a mediating inhibitory cell type that is feature-tuned and suppresses excitatory neurons. Indeed, recent data show that somatostatin-positive (SST) interneurons have both properties. We further predict that, relative to untuned ensembles, cotuned ensembles suppress parvalbumin-positive but facilitate SST neurons, and link both effects to SST response variance. This framework reveals how nonlinear inhibition sculpts cortical dynamics and establishes a predictive theory for targeted optogenetics.
items.abstract_zh: 光遗传学能对皮层活动进行因果操控。要预测网络介导的、常常反直觉的扰动响应，理论不可或缺。已有方法多依赖线性近似，在多神经元全息扰动下可能失效。我们针对具有细胞类型特异性结构连接的网络，建立了这类扰动的非线性响应理论，并应用于小鼠 V1 数据，观察到「共调谐集群抑制」：扰动空间聚集、偏好朝向相似的神经元，产生的短程抑制强于扰动未调谐集群。我们证明共调谐集群抑制需要非线性抑制通路，并预测存在一类对特征调谐、且抑制兴奋性神经元的介导细胞类型——近期数据显示生长抑素阳性（SST）中间神经元兼具这两种性质。我们进一步预测，相对未调谐集群，共调谐集群会抑制小清蛋白阳性（PV）神经元而易化 SST 神经元，并将两种效应与 SST 响应方差联系起来。该框架揭示了非线性抑制如何塑造皮层动力学，为靶向光遗传学建立了可预测理论。
items.highlight_zh: 共调谐集群抑制依赖非线性抑制通路，预测 SST 介导
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】光遗传学用光开启或关闭特定神经元，是研究皮层因果机制的利器。但扰动一个神经元后，网络会通过连接把影响扩散出去，实际观测到的响应常常反直觉，因此需要理论来预测。以往理论多用线性近似，当用全息光遗传同时扰动多个神经元时，这种近似可能失效。

【用了什么方法】作者针对具有细胞类型特异性结构连接的神经网络，建立了多神经元扰动响应的非线性理论，并用小鼠初级视皮层（V1）的实验数据加以检验。

【有什么结果】数据中出现「共调谐集群抑制」：扰动空间上聚集、偏好朝向相似的神经元，比扰动偏好朝向混杂（未调谐）的集群产生更强的短程抑制。理论表明这必须由非线性抑制通路来解释，并预测存在一类「自身对特征调谐、且抑制兴奋性神经元」的抑制性细胞。已知生长抑素阳性（SST）中间神经元恰好兼具这两个性质。理论还预测：相对未调谐集群，共调谐集群会抑制小清蛋白阳性（PV）神经元而易化 SST 神经元，且这两种效应都与 SST 神经元的响应方差相关。

【为何重要】它把「扰动一群神经元会发生什么」从难以捉摸的经验观察，变成可由网络连接结构与细胞类型推断的定量预测，指出非线性抑制是塑造皮层动力学的重要机制，也为设计更精准的靶向光遗传实验提供理论依据。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Orientation-Tunable Interfacial Thermal Conductance in Lateral MoSe2/MoS2 Heterostructures: A Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics Study
items.title_zh: 横向MoSe₂/MoS₂异质结中可随取向调控的界面热导：深度势分子动力学研究
items.abstract_en: Managing heat flow across interfaces in lateral 2D transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures is a key challenge for next-generation nanoelectronic and optoelectronic devices. To tackle this, we trained a deep learning interatomic potential (DLP) using DeePMD-kit on density functional theory (DFT) data, then paired it with non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) simulations to study interfacial thermal conductance (ITC) in lateral MoSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ heterostructures, considering both armchair and zigzag interface orientations. The potential we trained closely matches DFT energies, forces, and phonon dispersion relations, which confirms its reliability for thermal transport simulations. Examining cell lengths from 10 to 40 nm and extrapolating to infinite length, the armchair interface shows a higher ITC (473 MW/m$^2$K) than the zigzag interface (387 MW/m$^2$K), and the armchair interface remains higher at every length considered. Both increase further as temperature rises. At 300 K, the vibrational density of states shows greater phonon spectral overlap at the armchair interface than at the zigzag interface. Together, these results offer a solid machine-learning framework for studying heat transport in lateral TMD heterostructures, and identify interface orientation as an effective means of controlling heat dissipation at these junctions.
items.abstract_zh: 在横向二维过渡金属硫族化物（TMD）异质结中管理跨界面热流，是下一代纳电子与光电子器件面临的关键挑战。本研究基于密度泛函理论（DFT）数据，用DeePMD-kit训练了深度学习原子间势（DLP），并结合非平衡分子动力学（NEMD）模拟，研究横向MoSe₂/MoS₂异质结的界面热导（ITC），同时考虑armchair与zigzag两种界面取向。所训练势函数在能量、力和声子色散关系上与DFT高度吻合，验证了其用于热输运模拟的可靠性。将元胞长度从10 nm扫描至40 nm并外推至无限长后，armchair界面的ITC为473 MW/m²K，高于zigzag界面的387 MW/m²K，且在各长度下armchair界面始终更高；两者均随温度升高而增大。300 K下的振动态密度显示，armchair界面的声子谱重叠强于zigzag界面。该工作为横向TMD异质结热输运研究提供了可靠的机器学习框架，并表明界面取向可有效调控此类结区的散热。
items.highlight_zh: 机器学习势揭示armchair界面热导高于zigzag，界面取向可调控散热
items.digest_zh:
【研究问题】二维材料做成的横向异质结（同一平面内两种材料拼接）在纳米器件中很常见，拼接处的“界面”会阻碍热量通过。学界已知界面取向（原子排列方向）可能影响导热，但对MoSe₂/MoS₂这类横向异质结缺乏定量、可靠的模拟手段——传统经验势精度不足，DFT又算不了大体系。
【方法】作者先用密度泛函理论（DFT）算出大量原子构型的能量与受力，再用DeePMD-kit训练深度学习原子间势（DLP），并检验其能否复现DFT的能量、力和声子色散关系；随后把该势接入非平衡分子动力学（NEMD），构建armchair和zigzag两种界面取向的模型，通过施加温差测界面热导（ITC）。为消除有限尺寸效应，他们把模拟元胞从10 nm加长到40 nm并外推到无限长。
【结果】外推后armchair界面ITC约473 MW/m²K，zigzag约387 MW/m²K，且在所有模拟长度上armchair都更高；温度升高时两者都增大。300 K下计算振动态密度发现，armchair界面两侧声子谱重叠更多，这解释了其更高的热导。
【意义】一方面，这说明训练好的深度学习势能可靠替代DFT做纳米尺度热输运模拟，形成可复用的机器学习框架；另一方面，它给出一个简单实用的工程结论：通过选择界面取向就能调节结区散热，对设计纳米电子与光电子器件的热管理有直接参考价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Horizontal Flow Matching for Single-Cell Spatiotemporal Dynamics
items.title_zh: 面向单细胞时空动力学的水平流匹配
items.abstract_en: Learning the spatiotemporal dynamics of cells from spatial transcriptomics requires connecting snapshots of different cells acquired in different coordinate frames. A rotation or translation of a section can appear as cell movement and distort the inferred correspondence. We introduce horizontal flow matching, which learns changes in tissue organization, molecular state, and cell abundance up to shared rigid motion. The dynamics follow a continuity--reaction equation whose action assigns no cost to shared rigid motion, and the resulting horizontal projector removes this component from spatial prediction errors during learning and from predicted velocities during generation. An equivalent endpoint problem jointly estimates correspondence and relative pose in Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao geometry and yields analytic paths whose velocity and growth serve as regression targets. Regressing these targets recovers the horizontal dynamics under ideal population conditions. Our model, HORIZON, uses an equivariant transformer to predict velocity and growth from the current tissue, so that a tissue can be generated continuously from a single initial snapshot. On a simulated tissue observed in perturbed coordinate frames, alignment improves reconstruction and projection reduces rigid drift. On four spatial transcriptomics time courses, HORIZON reconstructs tissue geometry, gene expression, and cell abundance more accurately than existing spatial and unbalanced trajectory methods, and interpolates held-out developmental stages.
items.abstract_zh: 从空间转录组数据学习细胞时空动力学，需要把在不同坐标系下采集的细胞快照对应起来。切片的一个旋转或平移就可能被误读为细胞运动，从而扭曲推断出的对应关系。为此，作者提出“水平流匹配”，在只考虑共同刚体运动的前提下学习组织结构、分子状态和细胞丰度的变化。其动力学遵循连续性—反应方程，该方程的作用量对共同刚体运动不施加代价，由此得到的水平投影算子在学习时从空间预测误差中、在生成时从预测速度中剔除该分量。一个等价的端点问题在Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao几何下联合估计对应关系与相对位姿，给出解析路径，其速度与增长量作为回归目标；原则上，在理想群体条件下回归这些目标即可恢复水平动力学。模型HORIZON用等变Transformer从当前组织预测速度与增长，因而可由单张初始快照连续生成组织。在坐标受扰动的模拟组织上，对齐改善了重建，投影抑制了刚体漂移；在四组空间转录组时间序列上，HORIZON在重建组织几何、基因表达和细胞丰度方面优于现有空间与不平衡轨迹方法，并能插值出留出的发育阶段。
items.highlight_zh: 水平流匹配剔除切片刚体位姿干扰，更准重建单细胞时空发育
items.digest_zh:
【研究问题】空间转录组能在保留位置信息的同时测出每个细胞的基因表达，但通常是“一次性”切片，想还原发育过程就要把不同时间点、甚至不同切片的数据串起来。麻烦在于：不同切片摆放时存在整体旋转或平移，而算法常常把这种整体位移误当成“细胞在移动”，于是推断出的细胞轨迹被扭曲。
【方法】作者提出“水平流匹配”。核心思想是：把数据里所有细胞共同的刚体运动（旋转+平移）视为无关信息，从动力学中剥离，只学剩余部分——组织如何变形、细胞状态如何转变、各状态细胞数量如何增减。具体做法是建立在连续性—反应方程上的模型，其“水平投影算子”会把刚体运动分量从学习时的空间预测误差和生成时的速度场里扣掉；同时证明等价的端点问题可在Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao几何下解析求出路径，其速度和增长率直接当作回归目标。最终模型HORIZON用等变Transformer从当前组织预测速度与增长，因此只需一张初始快照就能连续生成后续时空。
【结果】在坐标被刻意扰动的模拟组织上，加入对齐后重建更准、投影明显抑制了刚体漂移；在四个真实空间转录组时间序列上，HORIZON在重建组织几何、基因表达和细胞丰度上优于现有的空间轨迹与不平衡最优传输方法，还能合理插值出被留出的中间发育阶段。
【意义】它把“测序切片如何摆放”这一常被忽视的干扰因素正式建模并消除，为用空间转录组重建发育与疾病进程提供了更稳健的工具。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Syllable- and Word-Level Evaluation of Tibetan OCR
items.title_zh: 藏文OCR的音节级与词级评测
items.abstract_en: Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $τ\geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. On the effect of joint training, CER and SER record significant changes of opposite sign in 7 of 64 comparisons. SER needs no segmenter and ranks systems as SWER does under two of the three segmenters ($τ\geq 0.889$). The output of each configuration is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated, and each result is compared with that obtained on the reference text. As rough guidance, translation chrF of 60 is reached at SER of 0.047 or below and part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 at 0.078 or below, while no error rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not.
items.abstract_zh: 藏文OCR目前几乎只用字符错误率（CER）评价。藏文标注音节边界但不标注词边界，所以计算词错误率必须先分词。本研究评测九种识别器配置，覆盖排版体、木刻版和两种手写体（单独及组合），同时报告音节级与词级错误率，据作者所知这是藏文OCR的首例。配置包括CTC模型、带与不带训练后量化的TrOCR编解码器，以及一个视觉语言模型，每项均在CER、音节错误率（SER）和三种分词方案下的词错误率（SWER）下打分。CER对系统的排序大体与更高层级指标一致（Kendall τ≥0.833），仅一对系统排序相反。关于联合训练的影响，在64组比较中有7组CER与SER出现符号相反的显著变化。SER无需分词器，其在三种分词器中的两种下对系统的排序与SWER一致（τ≥0.889）。作者还对每种配置的输出做了词性标注、命名实体标注和机器翻译，并与参考文本上的结果对比。粗略而言，SER≤0.047时翻译chrF可达60，SER≤0.078时词性保持率可达0.8，但没有哪个错误率能把实体保持率达0.6的系统与未达者区分开。
items.highlight_zh: 首次给出藏文OCR音节级与词级评测，SER可替代分词词错误率
items.digest_zh:
【研究问题】藏文的书写习惯是标出音节边界、却不标词边界，这给OCR评测出了难题：最常用的字符错误率（CER）太细，看不出下游任务好坏；想问“词错多少”就必须先分词，而分词本身又有多种方案、结果不稳。作者因此系统比较不同粒度的评测指标，并检验它们是否与下游任务（词性、实体、翻译）表现一致。
【方法】作者评测九种识别器配置：CTC类模型、TrOCR编解码器（含与不含训练后量化），以及一个视觉语言模型；数据涵盖排版体、木刻版和两种手写体风格，既有单风格训练也有联合训练。每个配置同时用CER、音节错误率（SER）和三种不同分词器下的词错误率（SWER）打分，并比较各指标的排序一致性（Kendall τ）。再把各配置的输出做词性标注、命名实体识别和机器翻译，与参考文本结果对比，看哪个错误率最能预测下游质量。
【结果】CER给出的系统排序与更高层级指标大体一致（τ≥0.833），只有一对系统排序相反；在联合训练的影响上，64组比较中有7组CER与SER的显著变化方向相反——说明只看CER会得出相反结论。SER不需要分词器，且在三种分词器中的两种下与SWER排序一致（τ≥0.889）。在任务阈值上，SER≤0.047时翻译chrF可达60，SER≤0.078时词性保持率达0.8；但实体保持率0.6这一档无法靠任何错误率划出界线。
【意义】这是藏文OCR首个音节级与词级评测，为这一低资源文字给出了可操作的评测建议：SER免分词、稳定、贴近下游效果，可作为CER与分词词错误率之间的折中指标，也提醒研究者字符级指标可能掩盖真实差异。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出FAST-LIO2：一个快速、鲁棒且通用的LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。它建立在高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波之上，并有两项关键创新使其实现快速、鲁棒、精确的LiDAR导航与建图。第一项是直接把原始点云配准到地图上（并随之更新地图，即建图），无需提取特征。这样可利用环境中的细微特征，从而提高精度；去掉人工设计的特征提取模块，也使框架自然适配不同扫描模式的新型LiDAR。第二项创新是用增量式k-d树数据结构ikd-Tree维护地图，支持增量更新（点的插入与删除）和动态重平衡。与现有动态数据结构（八叉树、R*-树、nanoflann k-d树）相比，ikd-Tree整体性能更优，并天然支持在树上降采样。作者在多个公开LiDAR数据集的19条序列上做了详尽基准对比，FAST-LIO2以远低得多的计算量稳定取得更高精度。此外还针对小视场固态LiDAR开展了多项真实实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2计算高效（大型室外场景可达100 Hz里程计与建图）、鲁棒（在旋转角速度高达1000 deg/s的杂乱室内环境中仍能可靠估计位姿）、通用（适用于多线旋转与固态LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel与ARM处理器），且精度高于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 原始点云直接配准+增量ikd-Tree，实现100 Hz高精度LiDAR惯性里程计
items.digest_zh:
【研究问题】LiDAR-惯性里程计是机器人、无人机定位与建图的核心技术。此前的方案大多要先从点云中人工提取边缘、平面等特征再配准，问题是：特征提取规则是为特定扫描模式（如多线旋转式LiDAR）设计的，换用新兴的固态LiDAR就不适配；而且提取过程本身耗时，丢失了环境中细微但有用的几何信息；同时地图维护也常因频繁增删点而变慢。
【方法】FAST-LIO2保留高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波框架，做出两项关键改动。第一，直接配准：把原始点云点对点地配准到地图上，并顺带更新地图，彻底去掉人工特征提取。第二，自研增量式k-d树ikd-Tree来维护地图，支持点的插入、删除和动态重平衡，还天然支持在树上做降采样，从而避免重建整棵树。作者在多个公开数据集的19条序列上与其他先进系统做基准比较，并额外在视场很小的固态LiDAR上做真实实验。
【结果】在几乎全部序列上，FAST-LIO2以显著更低的计算开销取得更高精度；在大型室外环境可达100 Hz的里程计与建图频率，在杂乱的室内场景中即使旋转角速度高达1000 deg/s也能稳定输出位姿。框架可在多线旋转式和固态LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel与ARM处理器上通用。
【意义】它证明了“不用特征提取”的直接法不仅可行而且更准更快、更易适配新硬件，ikd-Tree也作为通用数据结构对后续建图系统有独立价值；这套开源方案已成为该领域被广泛采用的基线。

items.title_en: NereidVLA: Learning to Understand and Navigate the Underwater World
items.title_zh: NereidVLA：学习理解与导航水下世界
items.abstract_en: Underwater navigation requires translating visual spatial cues into motion, yet marine vision-language datasets rarely include paired robot trajectories. We present NereidVLA, a vision-language-action model that transfers marine spatial knowledge to language-conditioned 3D navigation. We first train Sea2Know on approximately two million marine examples to learn target grounding, spatial relations, and scene structure without paired robot-motion supervision. We then adapt it using expert trajectories executed under simulated underwater vehicle dynamics. Given RGB histories and a language instruction, NereidVLA predicts discrete motion tokens that decode into local 3D trajectories for closed-loop tracking. Evaluation combines an independent six-dimensional underwater navigation understanding benchmark with offline prediction and closed-loop navigation. Under matched navigation training and execution settings, marine spatial pretraining increases simulation success from 72.4% to 84.4%. Without fine-tuning on the real test environment, NereidVLA achieves 78.75% success in laboratory-pool robot trials, compared with 47.50% for InternVLA-N1. These results show that marine spatial supervision can support downstream motion learning and physical underwater navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 水下导航需要把视觉空间线索转化为运动，但海洋视觉-语言数据集很少包含配对的机器人轨迹。为此我们提出 NereidVLA，一个把海洋空间知识迁移到语言条件三维导航的视觉-语言-动作模型。我们先用约两百万条海洋样本训练 Sea2Know，在无需配对机器人运动监督的情况下学习目标定位、空间关系与场景结构；再用仿真水下潜器动力学下采集的专家轨迹进行适配。给定 RGB 历史与语言指令，NereidVLA 预测离散运动 token，并解码为局部三维轨迹以闭环跟踪。评测结合独立的六维水下导航理解基准、离线预测与闭环导航。在匹配设置下，海洋空间预训练把仿真成功率从 72.4% 提升到 84.4%；未在真实测试环境微调时，NereidVLA 在实验室水池试验中达到 78.75% 成功率，InternVLA-N1 仅为 47.50%。
items.highlight_zh: 海洋空间预训练大幅提升水下视觉-语言-动作导航成功率
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：水下机器人要听懂“游到那块礁石附近”这类指令并自主航行，但海洋视觉-语言数据几乎没有配对的机器人运动轨迹，直接训练视觉-语言-动作模型严重缺数据。
方法：作者走两步。第一步用约 200 万条海洋图文样本训练 Sea2Know，让模型学会认目标、理解空间关系和场景结构，这一步不需要任何机器人轨迹。第二步把这份“海洋空间常识”接到动作预测上，用仿真水下潜器动力学下采集的专家轨迹做适配；模型输入历史 RGB 图像和语言指令，输出离散运动 token，解码成局部三维轨迹供闭环跟踪。
结果：在导航训练与执行设置匹配时，海洋空间预训练把仿真成功率从 72.4% 提到 84.4%；在实验室水池的真实机器人试验中，模型没有在真实环境微调也达到 78.75% 成功率，而 InternVLA-N1 只有 47.50%。
为何重要：它验证了“先学海洋空间常识、再学怎么动”的两段式路线可以缓解数据稀缺，使水下 VLA 在真实水池中直接具备可用性能，为水下自主作业提供了可复制的范式。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: AmyloCore-ML: AI/Machine Learning Enabled Identification of Amyloid Fibril Core Regions Using Protein Language Models
items.title_zh: AmyloCore-ML：利用蛋白语言模型与机器学习识别淀粉样纤维核心区域
items.abstract_en: Identification of amyloid forming regions in proteins remains central to understanding of their aggregation behaviour, which are central to various neurodegenerative and systemic disorders. Many predictors have been designed to identify amyloid forming regions, however they may not necessarily identify total residues found in actual disease associated fibril structures. To address this, we formed a sequence-based based predictor-AmyloCore-ML to ascertain structural amyloid-core propensity. The predictor was developed using experimentally determined fibril structures obtained from Amyloid Atlas. Ordered residues in the experimental structures were designated as core, and unresolved sampled from the same proteins as matched controls as non-core. Core and non-core regions were encoded using various physicochemical descriptors and protein language model (PLM) embeddings (ESM-2, ANKH, ProtT5) and evaluated using protein-grouped cross-validation. PLMs consistently outperformed physicochemical descriptors, with the best models reaching AUROC values of ~0.88 and AUPRC values of ~0.85. Locked full-length protein scans further localized experimental cores, with ESM-2/ExtraTrees achieving AUROC 0.833, AUPRC 0.751, and a mean peak distance of 12.4 residues. In comparative benchmarking, our predictor showed better performance metrics than CrossBeta and AggrescanAI. The framework therefore provides residue-resolved prediction of structurally incorporated amyloid-core regions directly from sequence.
items.abstract_zh: 识别蛋白中的淀粉样形成区域是理解其聚集行为的关键，而聚集行为与多种神经退行性疾病和系统性疾病密切相关。已有预测器未必能识别实际疾病相关纤维结构中包含的全部残基。为此我们构建了基于序列的预测器 AmyloCore-ML，用于判断结构性淀粉样核心倾向。该预测器基于 Amyloid Atlas 的实验解析纤维结构开发：结构中有序残基定义为核心，同一蛋白中未解析区域采样作为匹配的非核心对照。核心与非核心区域用多种理化描述符与蛋白语言模型（ESM-2、ANKH、ProtT5）嵌入编码，并以按蛋白分组的交叉验证评估。蛋白语言模型始终优于理化描述符，最佳模型 AUROC 约 0.88、AUPRC 约 0.85。锁定全长蛋白扫描可进一步定位实验核心，ESM-2/ExtraTrees 达到 AUROC 0.833、AUPRC 0.751，平均峰距 12.4 个残基。在与 CrossBeta、AggrescanAI 的对比基准中表现更优，实现了直接从序列进行残基分辨的淀粉样核心预测。
items.highlight_zh: 用蛋白语言模型从序列直接定位淀粉样纤维核心残基
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：蛋白质为何会聚集成淀粉样纤维、哪些片段真正进入纤维核心，是理解阿尔茨海默病等疾病的关键。已有预测器多针对“易聚集片段”，却不一定对应实验结构中真正有序的纤维核心残基，二者并不等价。
方法：作者以 Amyloid Atlas 中的实验纤维结构为金标准，把结构里有序的残基标为“核心”，把同一蛋白中未解析到的区域采样为匹配的“非核心”对照。序列用两类特征编码：传统理化描述符，以及三种蛋白语言模型（ESM-2、ANKH、ProtT5）的嵌入；训练时采用按蛋白分组的交叉验证，避免同源蛋白泄漏造成虚高。
结果：蛋白语言模型明显优于手工理化特征，最佳模型 AUROC 约 0.88、AUPRC 约 0.85；在完整蛋白序列上滑动扫描时，预测峰值与实验核心的平均距离约 12.4 个残基；指标优于 CrossBeta 和 AggrescanAI。
为何重要：只要给出氨基酸序列，就能得到残基级别的“结构性核心”预测，帮助实验者优先锁定值得做截短或结构验证的片段，对淀粉样疾病机制研究和抑制剂设计都有直接价值。

items.title_en: Beyond Corpus-Driven Imitation: Evolving Musical Mindsets in the Agentic Orchestra via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 超越语料模仿：用子强化学习在智能体乐团中演化音乐“心智”
items.abstract_en: This paper presents a framework for computer-aided music composition and performance based on quantum reinforcement learning and multi-agent interaction. We introduce the agentic orchestra, where musical agents evolve distinct mindsets through trial-and-error engagement with a musical environment, rather than through training on large datasets. The agents are implemented as parameterised quantum circuits. They evolve distinct compositional behaviours, referred to as mindsets. This enables the exploration of musical decision spaces using quantum superposition and entanglement within a hybrid quantum-classical loop. We present two complementary agent architectures: atomistic agents, which process pitch and rhythm independently, and holistic agents, which handle pitch and duration as unified note events. Mindsets are shaped through musically grounded reward functions, which can be combined and weighted to develop different mindsets across agents. The resulting system positions quantum computing agents less as autonomous composers and more as adaptive musical partners, each developing its own musical personality through interaction rather than imitation. Demonstrations show how agents generalise their learned behaviour to previously unseen material, operating in interactive and offline batch modes using MIDI-encoded music. While quantum computers are still in development, experiments conducted on IBM quantum hardware confirmed that musically meaningful learning is achievable with existing quantum computers. For composers and performers, the agentic orchestra opens new possibilities for emergent, process-oriented musical creativity, offering a scalable foundation for quantum computer-aided music composition as quantum computing technology continues to advance.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个基于量子强化学习与多智能体交互的计算机辅助音乐创作与演奏框架。我们引入“智能体乐团”：音乐智能体通过与音乐环境反复试错演化出不同的“心智”，而非依赖大规模数据集训练。智能体以参数化量子电路实现，借助量子叠加与纠缠在混合量子-经典回路中探索音乐决策空间。我们给出两种互补架构：原子式智能体分别处理音高与节奏，整体式智能体把音高与时值视为统一音符事件。心智由有音乐依据的奖励函数塑造，可组合加权以在不同智能体上形成不同心智。系统把量子智能体定位为自适应音乐伙伴而非自主作曲家，各自通过交互而非模仿发展音乐个性。演示表明智能体能将所学行为泛化到未见材料，并支持交互与离线批处理模式下的 MIDI 音乐；IBM 量子硬件上的实验确认现有量子计算机已可实现有音乐意义的学习。
items.highlight_zh: 量子强化学习智能体靠试错长出各自的音乐“心智”
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：当前 AI 作曲多依赖海量作品模仿，风格容易趋同。能否让机器像真人乐手那样，通过与音乐环境反复互动、试错，逐步形成各自的音乐个性？
方法：作者搭建“智能体乐团”。每个音乐智能体是一个参数化量子电路，在混合量子-经典回路中利用量子叠加与纠缠探索音乐决策空间，用强化学习在“有音乐依据”的奖励函数驱动下演化出所谓“心智”。他们设计了两种架构：原子式智能体把音高与节奏分开处理，整体式智能体把音高与时长当作统一的音符事件；奖励项可以组合加权，从而让不同智能体形成不同取向。
结果：各智能体演化出彼此不同的作曲行为，并能把学到的行为泛化到训练中未见的音乐材料；系统支持实时交互和离线批处理两种模式，输入输出为 MIDI 编码音乐；在 IBM 量子硬件上的实验证实，现有量子设备已足以完成有音乐意义的学习。
为何重要：它把量子智能体定位为“会回应的音乐伙伴”而非自动作曲家，为过程导向、涌现式的音乐创作提供新思路，也为量子计算在创意领域的落地探路。不过当前量子硬件规模有限，实际创作效果仍属早期探索。

items.title_en: Latent Action Policies from Suboptimal Data
items.title_zh: 从次优数据中学习隐动作策略
items.abstract_en: Latent Action Models (LAMs) learn control representations from action-free video, but existing pipelines typically train latent policies with behavioral cloning, without an explicit policy improvement objective. Although offline RL offers a natural approach to policy improvement, standard methods do not transfer directly to learned latent action spaces. We find that the structure of learned latent actions makes naive offline RL unreliable: directly maximizing value over latent actions or fitting a unimodal policy can produce latent actions that cannot be realized by physical execution, while the latent representation can merge physical controls that receive different rewards. To understand when latent-space optimization remains valid, we derive conditions under which policy improvement transfers to decoded execution and under which latent and physical optima align. Building on these insights, we propose LAPIS for goal-conditioned latent policy improvement, grounding value-based policy improvement in observed state-latent transitions and using a conditional flow policy to capture their multimodal structure. LAPIS outperforms baselines on most tasks, with the clearest gains in visual manipulation, and remains effective even with only 1% action labels, where competing methods largely collapse.
items.abstract_zh: 隐动作模型（LAM）可从无动作视频中学习控制表征，但现有流程通常用行为克隆训练隐策略，缺乏显式的策略改进目标。离线强化学习是实现策略改进的自然途径，然而标准方法无法直接迁移到学习到的隐动作空间。我们发现隐动作的结构会让朴素离线 RL 不可靠：直接在隐动作上最大化价值或拟合单峰策略，可能产生物理执行无法实现的隐动作；隐表征还可能把获得不同奖励的物理控制合并在一起。为弄清隐空间优化何时仍然有效，我们推导了策略改进可迁移到解码执行、以及隐空间与物理最优对齐的条件。据此提出 LAPIS 进行目标条件隐策略改进：将基于价值的策略改进锚定在观测到的状态-隐动作转移上，并用条件流策略刻画其多峰结构。LAPIS 在多数任务上优于基线，视觉操作任务提升最明显，且仅用 1% 动作标签仍有效，此时对比方法大多崩溃。
items.highlight_zh: 揭示隐动作空间陷阱，提出可执行的隐策略改进方法 LAPIS
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：大量机器人视频没有动作标签，隐动作模型（LAM）能从中“猜”出控制量并据此训练策略，但现有流程只做行为克隆，没有显式的策略改进；若直接套用离线强化学习，又往往失效。
方法与发现：作者先诊断病因。在学到的隐动作空间里直接最大化价值，或拟合单峰策略，容易给出物理上执行不出来的隐动作；隐表征还可能把奖励不同的物理控制合并，导致优化方向错误。为此他们推导出两个条件：策略改进何时能安全迁移到解码后的真实执行，以及隐空间与物理空间的最优何时一致。基于此提出 LAPIS：把基于价值的策略改进锚定在真实观测到的“状态—隐动作”转移上，并用条件流策略刻画其多峰结构，而不是强行压成单峰。
结果：LAPIS 在多数任务上超过基线，视觉操作任务提升最明显；只用 1% 的真实动作标签仍保持有效，而对比方法在此设定下基本崩溃。
为何重要：它为“海量无标签视频 + 少量动作标签”的机器人学习提供了有理论依据的可行路线，使离线强化学习真正能用在学习到的隐动作空间里。

items.title_en: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: Piccolo：通过递归自我改进实现决策模型与数据的协同演化
items.abstract_en: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Piccolo——参数规模从 0.8B 到 27B 的多模态决策模型家族，通过智能体数据工程与递归自我改进（RSI）让模型能力与训练数据协同演化。模型对通用文本与视觉判断、智能体执行框架、数据工作流和交互式游戏中的候选答案预测概率。Piccolo-27B 以 75.59 分位居 Decision Index Vision Full 榜首，Piccolo-9B 与 Piccolo-4B 分别为 68.35 与 67.46，三者在各自规模档的 Private 榜单均列第一。研究智能体分析模型行为、构建训练数据、开展实验并据此改进后续方案，语义切片与共享研究记忆将各环节串联。大规模 RSI 探索还给出三点反直觉发现，例如损失的持续下降可能与离散决策准确率脱钩、甚至使其变差。
items.highlight_zh: 决策模型与训练数据可递归协同自我演化
items.digest_zh:
• 研究的问题：文本与视觉判断、智能体调用、数据工作流、游戏等“决策”任务，要求模型对候选答案给出概率。但通常模型能力与训练数据各自独立演进，缺少让两者互相促进的机制。
• 方法：作者训练了 0.8B 到 27B 的多模态决策模型家族 Piccolo，用“智能体数据工程”让研究智能体自动分析模型行为、构造训练数据、运行实验，并用实验结果改进下一轮方案；语义切片与共享研究记忆把整个家族开发过程中的这些动作串联起来，形成递归自我改进（RSI）闭环。训练配方包含数十万条样例，其中数据筛选与反馈驱动的迭代是自我改进的关键。
• 结果：Piccolo-27B 在 Decision Index Vision Full 榜单以 75.59 分登顶，9B 与 4B 分别得 68.35、67.46，三者都在各自参数档的 Private 榜单排第一。
• 三个反直觉发现：①骨干网络与训练配方的协同适配比模型新旧更重要——在相同配方下，较早的骨干在视觉任务上可胜过更新一代；②定向的数据筛选能让 4B–9B 模型在专门工作流上比肩 27B 基线；③训练损失持续下降并不等于离散决策准确率提升，甚至可能变差。
• 为何重要：它给出可操作的“模型—数据协同演化”路线图，并随 Data-Juicer 与 AgentScope 生态开源权重与工具，便于复现和扩展数据驱动的 RSI。

items.title_en: RoboMorpher: Scaling Robot Morphology Representations for Cross-Embodiment Action Prediction
items.title_zh: RoboMorpher：扩展机器人形态表征以实现跨本体动作预测
items.abstract_en: Learning shared action representations is central to cross-embodiment manipulation. However, identical joint values can produce different spatial configurations across robots, limiting representations learned from joint values alone. We introduce RoboMorpher, a morphology-conditioned action tokenizer that jointly reconstructs joint angles and link poses to associate control coordinates with their kinematic effects. MorphGen supplies scalable kinematic supervision by generating serial-arm descriptions from survey-derived geometric priors. We pretrain RoboMorpher on 40 million morphology-state pairs and integrate the frozen tokenizer into a vision-language-action policy for discrete prediction and continuous refinement. We also introduce EmbodiBench, a ten-task benchmark with 30 generated URDFs per task. With downstream URDFs excluded from tokenizer pretraining, the policy achieves 56.40% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and 23.27% on EmbodiBench, exceeding continuous joint-space control by 9.73 and 15.34 percentage points. Removing link-pose supervision reduces EmbodiBench success by 17.94 percentage points, supporting morphology-aware geometric supervision for joint-action representation learning.
items.abstract_zh: 学习共享的动作表征是跨本体操作的核心，但相同的关节值在不同机器人上会产生不同的空间构型，因此仅凭关节值学到的表征存在局限。我们提出 RoboMorpher，一种以形态为条件的动作分词器，通过同时重建关节角与连杆位姿，把控制坐标与其运动学效果关联起来。MorphGen 依据调研得到的几何先验生成串联机械臂描述，提供可扩展的运动学监督。我们在 4000 万条形态-状态对上预训练 RoboMorpher，并把冻结的分词器接入视觉-语言-动作策略，用于离散预测与连续精修。我们还提出 EmbodiBench——包含 10 个任务、每任务 30 个生成 URDF 的基准。在下游 URDF 不参与分词器预训练的情况下，策略在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 56.40% 成功率，在 EmbodiBench 上达到 23.27%，分别比连续关节空间控制高 9.73 与 15.34 个百分点。移除连杆位姿监督会使 EmbodiBench 成功率下降 17.94 个百分点。
items.highlight_zh: 形态条件动作分词器让不同机器人共享动作表征
items.digest_zh:
• 研究的问题：希望不同形态的机器人共享一套动作表征，从而把在一个机器人上学到的操作能力迁移到另一个机器人。难点在于，相同的关节角数值在不同机器人上对应的空间构型完全不同，只看关节值的表征无法体现“这个动作在空间里到底做了什么”。
• 方法：提出 RoboMorpher——一个以机器人形态（运动学结构）为条件的动作分词器。训练时它不只重建关节角，还重建各连杆的位姿，从而把“控制坐标”与它产生的“运动学效果”绑定在一起。配套的 MorphGen 根据从调研中得到的几何先验自动生成串联机械臂的结构描述，可规模化地提供运动学监督。作者先在 4000 万条形态-状态对上预训练该分词器，再把冻结后的分词器接入视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，用离散 token 预测加连续精修来输出动作。
• 评测设计：构建 EmbodiBench，含 10 个任务、每任务 30 个自动生成的 URDF，并刻意让下游 URDF 不参与分词器预训练，以检验真正的跨本体泛化，而不是记住见过的本体。
• 结果：策略在 RoboTwin 2.0 上成功率 56.40%，在 EmbodiBench 上 23.27%，分别比连续关节空间控制高 9.73 和 15.34 个百分点；去掉连杆位姿监督后，EmbodiBench 成功率下降 17.94 个百分点。
• 意义：说明关键在于给关节动作表征配上“带几何含义的监督”，而不只是堆更多数据；这对跨本体机器人学习具有直接指导价值。

items.title_en: Retroactive Concept Bottleneck Models for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
items.title_zh: 面向无样本类增量学习的回溯概念瓶颈模型
items.abstract_en: Exemplar-free class-incremental learning (EFCIL) requires models to learn new classes sequentially without retaining training samples from previous tasks. Continual concept bottleneck models (CBMs) make their predictions interpretable by identifying visual concepts in an image and using them to score each class. However, these methods typically focus on preserving learned concepts or approximating past classes with generated features, which can leave new concepts underused in old-class predictions. We propose RetroCBM, which retains a small set of vocabulary-independent statistics relating frozen visual features to the embedding space of a pretrained vision-language model. Even after earlier training images have been discarded, we can use these statistics to supervise new concepts. To do so, we develop a retroactive regression rule that yields the same predictor for each new concept as class-balanced ridge regression on all images seen so far. We then reproject the stored statistics to recover the full-history squared classification loss and thus learn how much each new concept should contribute to old-class predictions. Since the classifier may use systematic concept errors to distinguish nearby classes, we further introduce a graph-weighted penalty on the margin shifts caused by those errors. Across six datasets, RetroCBM outperforms state-of-the-art interpretable methods in all class-incremental settings, with an 18.1\% relative gain in mean average incremental accuracy over the strongest exemplar-free baseline.
items.abstract_zh: 无样本类增量学习（EFCIL）要求模型在不保留先前任务训练样本的情况下依次学习新类。持续概念瓶颈模型（CBM）通过识别图像中的视觉概念并用其为每个类打分，使预测具有可解释性。然而，这些方法通常侧重于保留已学概念或用生成特征近似过去类别，这可能导致新概念在旧类预测中未被充分利用。我们提出 RetroCBM，它保留一小组与词表无关的统计量，将冻结视觉特征与预训练视觉-语言模型的嵌入空间关联起来。即使早期训练图像已被丢弃，我们仍可使用这些统计量监督新概念。为此，我们开发了一种回溯回归规则，使每个新概念得到的预测器与对迄今所见所有图像进行类平衡岭回归所得预测器相同。然后，我们重新投影存储的统计量以恢复全历史平方分类损失，从而学习每个新概念应对旧类预测贡献多少。由于分类器可能利用系统性概念错误来区分邻近类别，我们进一步对由这些错误引起的间隔偏移引入图加权惩罚。在六个数据集上，RetroCBM 在所有类增量设置中优于最先进的可解释方法，相较于最强的无样本基线，在平均平均增量准确率上取得 18.1% 的相对提升。

items.title_en: Generation of protein conformations using a simple inverted transformer
items.title_zh: 使用简单倒置 Transformer 生成蛋白质构象
items.abstract_en: Molecular dynamics is an extremely powerful approach for studying protein behavior, but it requires enormous computational resources to obtain an adequate sampling of possible conformations. Recently, thanks to successes in predicting three-dimensional protein structures, there has been an explosion of research exploring the opportunities offered by deep learning to address the problem of protein conformational landscape. In this work, an artificial intelligence system based on a variant of the Transformer architecture is introduced and applied to the problem of determining the ensemble of three-dimensional structures that a protein can access and their statistical weight. After being trained on a dataset of conformations of a particular protein obtained using classical all-atom molecular dynamics, this neural network is able to directly generate physically plausible protein conformations similar to those obtained both through molecular dynamics and experimentally. The ordered sequence of conformations obtained as output of the neural network rapidly converges towards the most populated regions of the protein's conformational landscape, suggesting that the system may have learned not only the protein's three-dimensional organization but also the thermodynamic weights of the various feasible conformations. These features, combined with its simplicity and low computational load, make this Transformer variant an ideal candidate for the development of systems capable of performing generative molecular dynamics.
items.abstract_zh: 分子动力学是研究蛋白质行为的极其强大的方法，但获得对可能构象的充分采样需要巨大的计算资源。近年来，得益于在预测蛋白质三维结构方面的成功，探索深度学习为解决蛋白质构象景观问题所提供机会的研究呈爆发式增长。本工作引入一个基于 Transformer 架构变体的人工智能系统，并将其应用于确定蛋白质可访问的三维结构集合及其统计权重的问题。在使用通过经典全原子分子动力学获得的特定蛋白质构象数据集训练后，该神经网络能够直接生成物理上合理的蛋白质构象，类似通过分子动力学和实验获得的构象。作为神经网络输出获得的有序构象序列迅速收敛到蛋白质构象景观中最密集的区域，这表明该系统可能不仅学习了蛋白质的三维组织，还学习了各种可行构象的热力学权重。这些特性，结合其简单性和低计算负载，使这一 Transformer 变体成为开发能够执行生成式分子动力学的系统的理想候选。

items.title_en: Observation of room-temperature intrinsic antiferroelectricity in van der Waals NbOCl2
items.title_zh: 范德华 NbOCl2 中室温本征反铁电性的观测
items.abstract_en: In recent years, two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectricity has been extensively investigated across a wide range of 2D materials, while intrinsic 2D antiferroelectricity remains exceptionally rare, limiting its implementation in next-generation photonic and electronic devices. Here, we report the observation of room-temperature-stable antiferroelectricity in the layered transition metal oxyhalide NbOCl2, and demonstrate a reversible, stimuli-driven antiferroelectric-to-ferroelectric (AFE-to-FE) phase transition in this material. Second-harmonic generation (SHG) mapping reveals a well-defined stripe-like spatial distribution of SHG intensity across as-grown NbOCl2 flakes spanning thickness from few-layer to bulk-like configurations. This distinctive SHG signature originates from the existence of antiferroelectric phase and the coexistence of antiferroelectric and ferroelectric phases within individual crystals, as evidenced by a combined incident-angle-dependent SHG measurement and Raman spectroscopy. By integrating NbOCl2 with one-dimensional silver nanowires, we achieve spatially selective, strain-mediated AFE-to-FE phase transition. Moreover, an ultralow electric field (~20 kV/cm) induces a reversible SHG response, consistent with switching from the centrosymmetric antiferroelectric state (SHG-silent) to the non-centrosymmetric ferroelectric state (SHG-active). This study not only expands the family of room-temperature 2D antiferroelectrics but also establishes a versatile platform for dynamic manipulation of nonlinear light, paving the way toward electric-field-programmable nonlinear photonics and optical information processing.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，二维（2D）铁电性已在多种二维材料中得到广泛研究，而本征二维反铁电性仍然极其罕见，限制了其在下一代光子和电子器件中的应用。在此，我们报道在层状过渡金属氧卤化物 NbOCl2 中观察到室温稳定的反铁电性，并证明该材料中存在可逆的、刺激驱动的反铁电到铁电（AFE-to-FE）相变。二次谐波产生（SHG）映射显示，在从少层到体状构型的生长态 NbOCl2 薄片上，SHG 强度具有明确的条带状空间分布。这种独特的 SHG 特征源于反铁电相的存在以及单个晶体中反铁电相和铁电相的共存，这由入射角相关 SHG 测量与拉曼光谱相结合所证明。通过将 NbOCl2 与一维银纳米线集成，我们实现了空间选择性的、应变介导的 AFE-to-FE 相变。此外，超低电场（约 20 kV/cm）诱导可逆的 SHG 响应，这与从中心对称反铁电态（无 SHG 信号）切换到非中心对称铁电态（有 SHG 信号）一致。本研究不仅扩展了室温二维反铁电体家族，还建立了一个用于动态操纵非线性光的多功能平台，为电场可编程非线性光子学和光学信息处理铺平了道路。

items.title_en: Hardware Acceleration of Vision-Language-Action Models with Weight Precision Rising over the Flow Steps
items.title_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型硬件加速：权重精度随流匹配步数递增
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models such as GR00T control robots through an action head: a diffusion transformer that turns noise into a chunk of actions in a few flow-matching steps. Every step re-reads all of the head's weights from DRAM but applies each weight to only about fifty tokens. Inference is therefore memory-bound, and its latency and energy are largely determined by the total number of transferred weight bits. We show that later flow steps attenuate the quantization errors of earlier steps, so the weight precision of an action head should rise over the steps. With plain per-channel rounding and without calibration or training, widths rising over the steps from 2 to 4 bits preserve the closed-loop success of robot policies. These widths transfer 25% fewer bits than 4-bit weights at every step. However, we show that on Jetson AGX Thor, current GPU kernels cannot exploit this per-step precision due to fixed overheads. We therefore present a programmable accelerator whose latency and energy both scale with the transferred weight bits. It decodes entropy-coded weights for bit-serial sub-arrays at the DRAM rate. Because the width changes per step, a run-time allocator divides these sub-arrays between the linear layers and the attention to balance their workloads. The same sub-arrays are thus capable of running action heads of different families and sizes, as well as a vision-language model. On the DRAM side, a requantizer and an entropy encoder at each bank let one stored 8-bit copy replace the copies of all widths. Simulated with LPDDR5X timing, our RTL implementation runs the GR00T N1.6 action head in 8.02 ms per inference with 2, 3, 3 and 4 bits in its four flow steps. With a copy per width and 50% of Thor's memory bandwidth, the accelerator runs this schedule 1.7x faster than Thor in NVFP4, at 9.1x less energy and equal closed-loop success.
items.abstract_zh: GR00T 等视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过“动作头”控制机器人：动作头是一个扩散 Transformer，在数步流匹配中把噪声变成一段动作。每一步都要从 DRAM 重新读取动作头的全部权重，而每个权重仅作用于约五十个 token，因此推理受内存带宽限制，延迟与能耗主要由传输的权重比特数决定。我们发现后续流步会衰减前序步骤的量化误差，因此权重精度应随步数上升。仅用逐通道取整、无需校准或训练，让位宽按步从 2 比特升至 4 比特即可保持机器人策略的闭环成功率，且比每步都用 4 比特少传 25% 的比特。由于 Jetson AGX Thor 上现有 GPU kernel 受固定开销限制而无法利用这一点，我们提出一种可编程加速器，其延迟与能耗随传输的权重比特数伸缩，并以位串行方式按 DRAM 速率解码熵编码权重。按 LPDDR5X 时序仿真的 RTL 实现以 2、3、3、4 比特运行 GR00T N1.6 动作头，每次推理耗时 8.02 ms。
items.highlight_zh: 权重精度随流步由2比特升至4比特，省25%传输
items.digest_zh:
• 研究的问题：GR00T 这类 VLA 模型靠一个“动作头”（扩散 Transformer）在少数几步流匹配中把噪声变成一整段动作。每一步都要把动作头所有模型权重从 DRAM 重新读一遍，但每个权重只作用于约五十个 token，运算量远小于搬运量。因此推理是典型的内存受限情形：延迟和能耗基本由“总共搬了多少比特的权重”决定。
• 核心洞察：后续流步会削弱前面流步引入的量化误差，所以每一步不必用同样的精度；让权重精度随步数递增更合理。作者只用逐通道取整，不做校准也不重新训练，让位宽按步从 2 比特升到 4 比特，就能保住机器人策略的闭环成功率，同时比“每步都是 4 比特”少传 25% 的比特。
• 方法与工程难点：Jetson AGX Thor 上现有 GPU kernel 因固定开销无法利用这种逐级精度，于是作者设计了可编程加速器，使延迟和能耗都随传输的权重比特数伸缩：按 DRAM 速率分别为每个位串行子阵列解码熵编码权重；由于每步位宽会变，用运行时分配器把子阵列在 linear 层与 attention 之间重新划分以平衡负载，同一批子阵列因此还能运行不同家族、不同规模的动作头甚至视觉语言模型；在 DRAM 侧，每个 bank 配有重量化器与熵编码器，用一份存储的 8 比特副本取代各精度下的多份副本。
• 结果：用 LPDDR5X 时序仿真 RTL 实现，按 2、3、3、4 比特的四步方案运行 GR00T N1.6 动作头，每次推理 8.02 ms。
• 意义：把“计算过程中精度可以变化”这一算法观察，变成了硬件能兑现的真实能效与带宽收益，为机器人端侧部署 VLA 提供了新思路。

items.title_en: Thinking Harder Doesn't Lead to Better Choices: Reasoning Effort Increases the Confidence but Not the Correctness of LLM Shopping Agents
items.title_zh: 更努力思考并不能带来更好选择：推理投入提升 LLM 购物代理的置信度而非正确性
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous shopping agents that process multimodal product listings (consisting of visual and text data) and recommend purchases on behalf of consumers. Naturally, one might assume that models with more thinking power would make higher-quality purchasing decisions. To test this belief, we ask two questions about such agents: does asking a model to think harder make it choose better products, and does the confidence it reports tell us the likelihood it may be wrong? We benchmark ten frontier models on three product-choice benchmarks built from WebShop, Amazon's SQID and Wayfair's WANDS platforms to see if LLMs with more thinking power actually make better-quality product purchase decisions. Across all three benchmarks, we found that increasing the thinking effort does not increase decision quality in a statistically meaningful way. The same change in thinking effort raises stated confidence at a statistically significant level, so extra thinking buys confidence rather than correctness. We also measure the calibration of these models (how well their reported confidence percentage matches their true correctness percentage) in these tasks and show that most models are not well-calibrated at every effort level. We also find that errors are strongly shared: when one model errs in a task, several others tend to err on that same task. Furthermore, on tasks where several models all err, a large number of them pick the same wrong product.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被部署为自主购物代理，它们处理多模态产品列表（由视觉和文本数据组成），并代表消费者推荐购买。人们自然会假设具有更强思考能力的模型会做出更高质量的购买决策。为检验这一信念，我们针对此类代理提出两个问题：要求模型更努力思考是否会使它选择更好的产品，以及它报告的置信度是否告诉我们其可能出错的可能性？我们在基于 WebShop、亚马逊 SQID 和 Wayfair WANDS 平台构建的三个产品选择基准上对十个前沿模型进行基准测试，以观察具有更强思考能力的 LLM 是否确实做出更高质量的产品购买决策。在所有三个基准上，我们发现增加思考投入并不会以统计显著的方式提高决策质量。同样的思考投入变化以统计显著水平提高了所报告的置信度，因此额外思考换来的是置信度而非正确性。我们还测量了这些模型在这些任务中的校准（其报告的置信度百分比与真实正确率百分比的匹配程度），并表明大多数模型在每个投入水平上都没有良好校准。我们还发现错误具有强共享性：当一个模型在某任务上出错时，其他几个模型也往往在同一任务上出错。此外，在多个模型都出错的任务上，其中大量模型选择了相同的错误产品。

items.title_en: SHAPE: Discrete Supervision and Parallel Continuous Streams for Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Human Data
items.title_zh: SHAPE：从自我中心人类数据学习灵巧操作的离散监督与并行连续流
items.abstract_en: Egocentric human recordings are far cheaper than dexterous robot demonstrations, promising stronger pretraining and direct skill learning without task-specific robot data. Yet humans and robots differ in morphology and kinematics, so human recordings lack the joint positions and actuator commands that supervise robot policies, providing only retargeted end-effector (EEF) actions. This raises two questions: how human data should supervise the policy, and how a dexterous robot should read out actions at deployment. We address both in SHAPE (Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams), a vision-language-action (VLA) model whose backbone predicts discrete action tokens of EEF chunks as an auxiliary task, while a shared flow-matching expert outputs two executable streams, EEF and joint. On a bimanual robot with 22-DoF hands, a matched study shows that discrete supervision helps learn from human data, driving backbone gradients and shaping action-informative representations across domains. Under standard control pipelines at deployment, direct joint readout excels at fine-grained control with robot demonstrations, scoring 0.80 across six tasks against 0.63 for π0.5, whereas IK-based EEF readout excels at human-to-robot transfer. Pretrained with human data and discrete tokens, SHAPE learns new tasks from human demonstrations without task-specific robot data.
items.abstract_zh: 自我中心人类记录远比灵巧机器人演示便宜，有望实现更强的预训练和无需任务特定机器人数据的直接技能学习。然而，人类和机器人在形态学和运动学上存在差异，因此人类记录缺乏监督机器人策略的关节位置和执行器命令，仅提供重定向末端执行器（EEF）动作。这引出两个问题：人类数据应如何监督策略，以及灵巧机器人在部署时应如何读出动作。我们在 SHAPE（Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams）中解决这两个问题；SHAPE 是一个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，其主干作为辅助任务预测 EEF 块的离散动作 token，而一个共享流匹配专家输出两个可执行流：EEF 和关节。在配备 22 自由度手的双臂机器人上，一项匹配研究表明，离散监督有助于从人类数据中学习，驱动主干梯度并在跨域中塑造具有动作信息性的表征。在部署时的标准控制流程下，直接关节读出在使用机器人演示进行细粒度控制方面表现出色，在六个任务上得分为 0.80，而 π0.5 为 0.63；而基于逆运动学（IK）的 EEF 读出则在人到机器人迁移方面表现出色。使用人类数据和离散 token 预训练后，SHAPE 可从人类演示中学习新任务，而无需任务特定的机器人数据。

items.title_en: Do Thinking VLMs Need to Keep Looking at Long Videos? Write It Down, Then Look Away
items.title_zh: 思考型 VLM 需要一直看长视频吗？写下来，然后移开视线
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) reason about long videos over hundreds to thousands of tokens. Every decoding step re-reads the key-value (KV) cache of the entire video. Must the model keep looking while it reasons? In LookAway, the model first writes timestamped notes on what the question needs and then puts the video away. Once the notes close, the inference engine hides the video's KV cache for the rest of the response. Across both hybrid and pure-attention VLMs, dependence on the video is concentrated early in the response. On Qwen3.6-27B, writing notes preserves accuracy better than free reasoning at the same withdrawal step. Replacing them with another video's notes harms accuracy, whereas keeping the video visible alongside the model's own notes adds no significant benefit. Without additional training, LookAway nearly matches full-video thinking accuracy at 0.12-0.13 times its modeled decode cost. To shorten this initial look, we fine-tune the model on its own correct LookAway responses. Reinforcement learning then rewards correct answers while penalizing KV reads. The trained model puts the video away after a median of 66-68 tokens. Across three held-out benchmarks, it writes more tokens than an identically trained full-video model yet reads only 27-35% as many KV positions at matched accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在数百到数千个 token 上对长视频进行推理。每个解码步骤都会重新读取整个视频的键值（KV）缓存。模型在推理时必须一直看视频吗？在 LookAway 中，模型首先就问题所需内容写下带时间戳的笔记，然后将视频收起。一旦笔记阶段结束，推理引擎在响应的剩余部分隐藏视频的 KV 缓存。在混合注意力和纯注意力 VLM 中，对视频的依赖都集中在响应早期。在 Qwen3.6-27B 上，在相同撤回步骤下，写笔记比自由推理更好地保持准确率。将笔记替换为另一个视频的笔记会损害准确率，而在保留模型自身笔记的同时保持视频可见没有显著收益。无需额外训练，LookAway 在建模解码成本的 0.12–0.13 倍下，几乎达到全视频思考的准确率。为缩短这一初始查看，我们用模型自身正确的 LookAway 响应对其进行微调。随后强化学习奖励正确答案，同时惩罚 KV 读取。训练后的模型在 66–68 个 token 的中位数后收起视频。在三个留出基准上，与同等训练的全视频模型相比，它写入更多 token，但在匹配准确率下只读取后者 27–35% 的 KV 位置。

items.title_en: Inferring Neural Activity Changes under Recording Uncertainty with Transformers and Variational Inference
items.title_zh: 在记录不确定性下用 Transformer 和变分推断推断神经活动变化
items.abstract_en: A difference in recorded firing rate across days may reflect a change in neuronal activity, missed spikes or recording a different neuron. We present a statistical approach that combines neuron tracking with Bayesian estimates of stationary mean recorded firing rates. Bounds under assumed differences in spike detection connect recorded rates to biological rate changes. We assess recording loss and uncertainty in rate changes in simulations, and count-model fit in recordings. We also compare two transformer estimators with Gaussian and flow variational inference under a shared temporal negative-binomial model. Flow variational inference agrees most closely with reference posteriors, while predictive performance varies across mice. Rate-change intervals contain true simulated changes less often than intended. In UnitMatch recordings from five mice, some inferred changes remain supported when spike detection is allowed to differ between days; others depend on equal detection. These interpretations require a correct neuron match. The approach identifies which inferred rate changes remain supported under specified recording assumptions and where uncertainty limits interpretation.
items.abstract_zh: 跨天记录到的放电率差异可能反映神经活动变化、漏检脉冲或记录到了不同神经元。我们提出一种统计方法，将神经元追踪与平稳平均记录放电率的贝叶斯估计相结合。在假设的脉冲检测差异下，边界将记录率与生物速率变化联系起来。我们在模拟中评估记录丢失和速率变化不确定性，并在记录中评估计数模型拟合。我们还在共享时间负二项模型下，比较使用高斯和流变分推断的两个 transformer 估计器。流变分推断与参考后验最接近，而预测性能因小鼠而异。速率变化区间包含真实模拟变化的频率低于预期。在来自五只小鼠的 UnitMatch 记录中，当允许不同天之间脉冲检测存在差异时，一些推断出的变化仍得到支持；另一些则依赖检测相同。这些解释需要正确的神经元匹配。该方法识别在指定记录假设下哪些推断速率变化仍得到支持，以及不确定性在何处限制解释。

items.title_en: Optical Neural Networks Should Be Evaluated by Function, Not Only Physics
items.title_zh: 光学神经网络应按功能评估，而不仅是物理特性
items.abstract_en: Optical neural networks (ONNs) are attracting significant attention as alternative platforms for machine learning (ML). In an ONN, an optical module often takes over part of the computation inside a digital ML pipeline. How much of the task does the optical module itself perform, and how much does it contribute to any claimed system-level advantages, such as throughput or energy? This paper offers a simple, function-oriented evaluation methodology. Whatever its internal physics, the optical module appears to the surrounding digital pipeline as a mapping between real-valued tensors. We therefore evaluate it in three steps: (i) define its boundary in the pipeline, as real-valued tensors in and out; (ii) replace it with standard digital modules to identify those that match the optical system's performance on the same task and metric; and (iii) state system-level claims, such as speed or energy, per inference against the performance-matched digital module. We summarize steps (i) and (ii) in an Expressivity Card and demonstrate its use on published ONN systems. This helps isolate the optical module's contribution and provides a concrete digital reference for assessing its claimed system-level advantages, without the need to understand the physics. While we focus on optical systems as the most prominent example, the same approach applies to any physical analog computing platform used in ML, wherever a physical module takes over part of a digital pipeline.
items.abstract_zh: 光学神经网络（ONN）作为机器学习的替代平台正受到广泛关注。在 ONN 中，光学模块通常接管数字 ML 流水线中的部分计算。光学模块自身执行多少任务，以及对任何声称的系统级优势（如吞吐量或能耗）贡献多少？本文提出一种简单的、面向功能的评估方法。无论其内部物理机制如何，光学模块对周围数字流水线而言表现为实值张量之间的映射。因此，我们分三步评估它：(i) 在流水线中定义其边界，即输入和输出为实值张量；(ii) 用标准数字模块替代它，以识别在相同任务和指标上与光学系统性能匹配的模块；(iii) 相对于性能匹配的数字模块，陈述每次推理的系统级声明，如速度或能耗。我们将步骤 (i) 和 (ii) 总结为 Expressivity Card，并在已发表的 ONN 系统上演示其用法。这有助于隔离光学模块的贡献，并为评估其声称的系统级优势提供具体的数字参考，而无需理解物理机制。虽然我们聚焦光学系统作为最突出的例子，但相同方法适用于 ML 中任何物理模拟计算平台，只要物理模块接管数字流水线的一部分。

items.title_en: Continual Tool-Space Extension Learning for Multimodal Agents
items.title_zh: 面向多模态智能体的持续工具空间扩展学习
items.abstract_en: Multimodal agents largely rely on generic tools such as cropping, search, and code execution, leaving specialist vision models outside their tool space. However, bringing such a model into an already trained agent is not straightforward. The challenge is to learn each new tool efficiently while retaining the ability to use existing ones. This work proposes COTEX, continual tool-space extension learning, that adds new tools at efficient adapter-level cost. COTEX locates two sets of parameter directions; one triggers a tool call and thereby opens a multi-turn reasoning trajectory, while the other determines which tool is chosen. The adapter of a new tool is restricted to the calling directions that leave earlier tool choices unaffected by orthogonal constraint. We further introduce a protocol that converts specialist models' existing task-specific annotations into verified tool-use trajectories. Experiments on two representative agents and three specialist tools show gains on ten vision-language benchmarks, with at most a 0.3-point drop on existing tools.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态智能体主要依赖裁剪、搜索和代码执行等通用工具，使专用视觉模型不在其工具空间内。然而，将此类模型引入已训练的智能体并非易事。挑战在于高效学习每个新工具，同时保留使用现有工具的能力。本文提出 COTEX，即持续工具空间扩展学习，以高效的适配器级成本添加新工具。COTEX 定位两组参数方向；一组触发工具调用，从而开启多轮推理轨迹，另一组决定选择哪个工具。新工具的适配器被限制在调用方向上，通过正交约束使先前工具选择不受影响。我们进一步引入一种协议，将专用模型已有的任务特定标注转换为经验证的工具使用轨迹。在两种代表性智能体和三种专用工具上的实验显示，在十个视觉语言基准上取得提升，现有工具上的下降最多为 0.3 个百分点。

items.title_en: Induction Head Origins of SLAM-ASR Speech Recognition Models
items.title_zh: SLAM-ASR 语音识别模型的归纳头起源
items.abstract_en: What makes a small trained map from encoder states to the embedding space of a frozen language model sufficient for competitive speech recognition? The premise of the SLAM-ASR architecture is that a frozen language model possesses linguistic knowledge rich enough to perform the recognition task. This assumption, while reasonable, provides little insight into the mechanisms underlying these models. We therefore seek the concrete internal structures on which they rely. This work shows that SLAM-ASR models rely on induction heads of the frozen language model: the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text are also important for mapping speech embeddings to transcript tokens. Moreover, we find pairs of heads that behave as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention onto the previously generated word. Finally, we show how induction heads could be used to improve transcription quality under noisy audio.
items.abstract_zh: 是什么使一个从编码器状态到冻结语言模型嵌入空间的、经训练的小型映射足以实现有竞争力的语音识别？SLAM-ASR 架构的前提是，冻结语言模型拥有足够丰富的语言知识来执行识别任务。这一假设虽然合理，但几乎无法揭示这些模型背后的机制。因此，我们寻找它们所依赖的具体内部结构。本工作表明，SLAM-ASR 模型依赖冻结语言模型的归纳头：在文本中复制重复 token 序列的同一批头，对于将语音嵌入映射到转写 token 也很重要。此外，我们发现成对的头表现出一种受限形式的差分注意力，抵消注意力噪声并将注意力锐化到先前生成的词上。最后，我们展示如何利用归纳头在含噪音频下提高转写质量。

items.title_en: Teaching VLMs What to Say, Not How to Reason: Rethinking Counterfactual Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 教 VLM 说什么，而非如何推理：重新审视自动驾驶中的反事实推理
items.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving systems have been shown to suffer from shortcut learning and causal confusion, limiting their ability to generalize robustly under distribution shift. To mitigate these limitations, recent works based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored incorporating linguistic reasoning capabilities into driving decision-making, reporting improvements in driving performance. In particular, counterfactual (CF) reasoning has been proposed to enable self-reflective, high-level causal understanding. However, it remains unclear whether the language-based reasoning mitigates shortcut learning or merely shifts it from visual representations to linguistic patterns, creating an illusion of causal understanding. Moreover, existing approaches often conflate intervention-based reasoning with CF reasoning, leaving the effects of genuine CF reasoning unexplored. In this work, we examine what CF reasoning actually induces in VLM-based autonomous driving and observe that it shifts the action distribution toward more conservative behaviors while increasing uncertainty in reasoning and decision-making. This effect persists under reinforcement fine-tuning, suggesting that it is not merely a transient artifact. Furthermore, visual attention analysis shows that CF reasoning does not alter visual grounding, while causal intervention experiments reveal that masking causally relevant and non-causal factors in accident scenarios results in comparable decision change rates. Overall, these results suggest that CF reasoning does not induce genuine causal reasoning grounded in visual evidence. Instead, it acts as a linguistic shortcut that reshapes the action distribution, teaching models what to say but not how to reason, highlighting a gap between language-based reasoning and causal understanding in autonomous driving.
items.abstract_zh: 端到端自动驾驶系统已被证明存在捷径学习和因果混淆，限制了其在分布偏移下稳健泛化的能力。为缓解这些限制，近期基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的工作探索将语言推理能力纳入驾驶决策，并报告驾驶性能提升。特别是，反事实（CF）推理被提出用于实现自反思的高层因果理解。然而，尚不清楚这种基于语言的推理是缓解了捷径学习，还是仅将其从视觉表示转移到语言模式，从而制造因果理解的错觉。此外，现有方法常将基于干预的推理与 CF 推理混为一谈，使真正 CF 推理的效果未被探索。在本工作中，我们考察 CF 推理在基于 VLM 的自动驾驶中实际诱导了什么，并观察到它使动作分布转向更保守的行为，同时增加推理和决策中的不确定性。这种效应在强化微调下仍然存在，表明它不仅仅是暂时性伪影。此外，视觉注意力分析表明 CF 推理不改变视觉 grounding，而因果干预实验揭示，在事故场景中遮蔽因果相关因素和非因果因素会导致可比的决策变化率。总体而言，这些结果表明 CF 推理并未诱导出基于视觉证据的真正因果推理。相反，它作为一种语言捷径重塑动作分布，教模型说什么而非如何推理，突显了自动驾驶中基于语言的推理与因果理解之间的差距。

items.title_en: PatchAdaNet: Unsupervised class incremental learning using local patches and global adapters
items.title_zh: PatchAdaNet：使用局部图像块和全局适配器的无监督类增量学习
items.abstract_en: Biological learning systems acquire knowledge incrementally through broad, reusable representations established early and kept largely stable, while integrating new experience with minimal interference with previously learned knowledge. Replay-based methods approximate this by storing samples or features from previous tasks and mixing them into the current task. However, memory buffers grow with the number of tasks and may retain task-specific noise that reduces generalization. To address these limitations, we propose PatchAdaNet (Patch Adapter Network), an unsupervised class-incremental learning method for image classification that continually updates feature representations using autoencoders. Since images share structural features such as edges, corners, and shapes, we first divide each image into patches and train independent autoencoders on external data to reconstruct each patch. The layers of all patch encoders are aggregated into global frozen layers that generalize across tasks and remain fixed throughout learning. Learnable adapters then build global image representations from these features to reconstruct the entire image. To prevent feature drift without storing data, we introduce the Global Feature Centroid (GFC), a fixed-size running average of adapter outputs updated after each task to penalizes representation drift. Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is applied to the learnable layers to preserve previously learned features by constraining important weights. Finally, a linear classifier is trained on the frozen latent representation and GFC for class-incremental evaluation. We evaluate PatchAdaNet in both CNN and Vision Transformer settings on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, miniImageNet and 5-Datasets, providing a comparative study of the two architectures under identical class-incremental settings. Code is available.
items.abstract_zh: 生物学习系统通过早期建立并基本保持稳定的大范围可复用表征来增量获取知识，同时在整合新经验时对先前学到的知识造成最小干扰。基于回放的方法通过存储先前任务的样本或特征并将其混入当前任务来近似这一过程。然而，记忆缓冲区随任务数量增长，并可能保留降低泛化能力的任务特定噪声。为解决这些限制，我们提出 PatchAdaNet（Patch Adapter Network），一种用于图像分类的无监督类增量学习方法，利用自编码器持续更新特征表征。由于图像共享边缘、角点和形状等结构特征，我们首先将每幅图像划分为图像块，并在外部数据上训练独立自编码器以重建每个图像块。所有图像块编码器的层被聚合为全局冻结层，这些层可跨任务泛化并在整个学习过程中保持固定。然后，可学习适配器从这些特征构建全局图像表征，以重建整个图像。为在不存储数据的情况下防止特征漂移，我们引入全局特征质心（Global Feature Centroid, GFC），它是适配器输出的固定大小滑动平均，在每个任务后更新，用于惩罚表征漂移。对可学习层应用弹性权重巩固（Elastic Weight Consolidation, EWC），通过约束重要权重来保留先前学到的特征。最后，在冻结的潜在表征和 GFC 上训练线性分类器，用于类增量评估。我们在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、miniImageNet 和 5-Datasets 上，在 CNN 和 Vision Transformer 两种设置下评估 PatchAdaNet，对两种架构在相同类增量设置下进行比较研究。代码已公开。

items.title_en: Scalable Non-Parametric Bayesian Inference of Free Energy Landscapes and Emission Functions from Observations
items.title_zh: 从观测数据对自由能景观和发射函数进行可扩展非参数贝叶斯推断
items.abstract_en: Free-energy landscapes govern processes from protein conformational change to climate oscillations, but are typically observed only indirectly, through observables such as FRET intensity or optical-tweezer transmittance. Neither the landscape shape, nor the emission function mapping latent state to signal, is usually known, and distinct states may produce the same signal. We therefore infer landscape and emission function jointly and non-parametrically, using the exact non-linear Bayesian filtering likelihood, to fully use the information contained in observable trajectories that are often noisy, scarce and costly to acquire. A novel parallel-in-time algorithm makes this tractable: it is up to 27 times faster than sequential filtering on one GPU, scales near-ideally across GPUs, and, given enough resources, has runtime independent of trajectory length. We demonstrate the method on a single-protein optical tweezer recording, where distinct conformations produce the same signal, and beyond biology on the El Nino-Southern Oscillation and financial market volatility.
items.abstract_zh: 自由能景观支配从蛋白质构象变化到气候振荡的过程，但通常只能通过 FRET 强度或光镊透射率等可观测量间接观测。景观形状以及将潜在状态映射到信号的发射函数通常均未知，且不同状态可能产生相同信号。因此，我们使用精确的非线性贝叶斯滤波似然，联合且非参数地推断景观和发射函数，以充分利用通常含噪、稀少且获取成本高的可观测轨迹中包含的信息。一种新的时间并行算法使该问题可处理：在单块 GPU 上，它比顺序滤波快最多 27 倍，在多 GPU 上接近理想扩展，并且在资源充足时运行时间与轨迹长度无关。我们在单蛋白光镊记录上演示该方法，其中不同构象产生相同信号；并在生物学之外，将方法应用于厄尔尼诺-南方涛动和金融市场波动率。

items.title_en: Application of Pretrained Universal Machine Learning Force-Fields for Phase Transitions Prediction in ZrO2
items.title_zh: 预训练通用机器学习力场在 ZrO2 相变预测中的应用
items.abstract_en: Pretrained universal machine-learning force fields can reduce the cost of finite-temperature molecular dynamics relative to density functional theory. However, most benchmarks test only static properties and do not assess whether these models reproduce the correct phase-transition sequence. Here, we benchmark ten open-source universal machine-learning force fields for zirconia (ZrO$_2$) using phonon dispersion calculations and variable-cell isothermal-isobaric molecular dynamics. Zirconia is a useful test because it has three thermodynamically stable crystalline phases prior to melting, following the sequence monoclinic-tetragonal-cubic. Four models reproduce this sequence: 7net-l3i5, MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M, MACE-mpa, and MACE-D3. Models with orthorhombic-tetragonal energy errors above about 10 meV/atom (7net-0, CHGNet, and MACE) instead produce an orthorhombic intermediate and predict monoclinic-orthorhombic-tetragonal-cubic-liquid upon heating. ORB-based models fail to sustain stable variable-cell dynamics because their phonon frequencies are compressed by 30-60% relative to the density functional theory reference. Across all ten models, two ground-state diagnostics predict finite-temperature behavior. Relative polymorph energetics should agree with the matched density functional theory reference within about 6 meV/atom, and the phonon spectrum should not show systematic softening. These diagnostics are practical screening metrics for assessing pretrained force fields for phase-transition predictions.
items.abstract_zh: 预训练通用机器学习力场相对于密度泛函理论可降低有限温度分子动力学的成本。然而，大多数基准仅测试静态性质，并未评估这些模型是否重现正确的相变序列。在此，我们使用声子色散计算和可变晶胞等温等压分子动力学，对十种用于氧化锆（ZrO2）的开源通用机器学习力场进行基准测试。氧化锆是有用的测试对象，因为其在熔化前具有三个热力学稳定的晶相，顺序为单斜-四方-立方。四个模型重现该序列：7net-l3i5、MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M、MACE-mpa 和 MACE-D3。正交-四方能量误差高于约 10 meV/atom 的模型（7net-0、CHGNet 和 MACE）反而产生正交中间相，并预测加热时依次为单斜-正交-四方-立方-液体。基于 ORB 的模型无法维持稳定的可变晶胞动力学，因为其声子频率相对于密度泛函理论参考被压缩了 30-60%。在所有十个模型中，两项基态诊断指标可预测有限温度行为。相对多晶型能量学应在约 6 meV/atom 内与匹配的密度泛函理论参考一致，且声子谱不应显示系统性软化。这些诊断指标是评估用于相变预测的预训练力场的实用筛选指标。
