items.title_en: Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement
items.title_zh: 将推理置于循环中：通过探究机制与测量进行抗体先导优化
items.abstract_en: Lab-in-the-loop systems, in which a model proposes molecules, automated assays measure their properties and the results retrain the model, are a popular approach to antibody lead optimization. These systems optimize for a specification defined with metrics computed from instrument signals, so their success depends on how well those metrics serve as proxies for the properties a drug candidate needs. When a metric is a poor proxy, neither a better model nor more data will fix it, and identifying the problem usually requires expert review. We report two campaigns run on BigHat Biosciences' Milliner platform, one on an anti-albumin nanobody (VHH) and one on an anti-mesothelin single-chain variable fragment (scFv), in which a research team and a general-purpose AI agent, Claude, brought scientific reasoning into the loop. Over seven rounds and about 1,010 design variants we built libraries from antibody lineage, structure and biophysics, and found from the raw curves that on each scaffold one thermal metric did not measure what its name implied. The libraries were built as controlled comparisons, so the results also show what each mutation contributes to each property. We fit a physical model of the curves, used it to choose metrics suited to each scaffold, and changed the experimental protocol, varying protein concentration and heating rate, to test the model against pre-registered predictions. Both leads improve on their parents in affinity, thermal stability and aggregation while improving or maintaining yield and purity.
items.abstract_zh: 实验室在环系统（模型提出分子、自动化测定测量其性质并用结果重新训练模型）是抗体先导优化的一种流行方法。这些系统针对由仪器信号计算出的指标所定义的规格进行优化，因此其成功取决于这些指标在多大程度上能作为候选药物所需性质的替代指标。当某项指标是不佳的替代指标时，更好的模型或更多数据都无法解决该问题，而识别该问题通常需要专家审查。我们报告在 BigHat Biosciences 的 Milliner 平台上开展的两项活动：一项针对抗白蛋白纳米抗体（VHH），另一项针对抗间皮素单链可变片段（scFv）；在这些活动中，一个研究团队和通用人工智能体 Claude 将科学推理引入循环。在七轮和约 1,010 个设计变体中，我们基于抗体谱系、结构和生物物理学构建文库，并从原始曲线发现，在每个骨架上，有一项热学指标并未测量其名称所暗示的内容。这些文库以受控比较方式构建，因此结果还显示每个突变对每种性质的贡献。我们拟合曲线的物理模型，用它选择适合每种骨架的指标，并改变实验方案（改变蛋白质浓度和加热速率），以根据预注册预测检验该模型。两个先导分子在亲和力、热稳定性和聚集方面均优于其亲本，同时提高或维持了产量和纯度。

items.title_en: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
items.title_zh: CurvDelta：用于精准学习与遗忘的低曲率增量建模
items.abstract_en: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.
items.abstract_zh: 适配大语言模型（LLM）的一个核心挑战是能力保持：适配可在实现目标的同时降低通用能力。我们提出 CurvDelta，一个可扩展框架，将保持约束纳入模型更新的参数化中。通过分析保持约束在适配前模型周围的局部几何，CurvDelta 构建一个低曲率空间，在该空间中参数更新使保持损失几乎不变。我们通过 Kronecker 因子近似曲率（K-FAC）和因子化投影，使该构建适用于 LLM。我们还提出 CurvLoRA，这是同一保持几何中的低秩变体，设计用于更高效的适配。两种方法均适用于保持约束的适配任务，如能力学习和选择性遗忘。我们在数学推理、代码生成和知识遗忘上评估我们的方法。对于数学推理和代码生成，我们的方法在取得有竞争力的下游性能的同时更好地保持通用能力，相对于基线提供了有利的获得-保持权衡。对于知识遗忘，我们在 TOFU 和 MUSE 上的主要结果表明，在目标遗忘与知识保持之间比基线取得更好的平衡，保持性能接近从头重新训练参考。

items.title_en: Single-Controller Teleoperation and Multimodal Dataset Generation for a Mobile Manipulator
items.title_zh: 面向移动机械臂的单控制器遥操作与多模态数据集生成
items.abstract_en: Robot learning systems require synchronized, high-quality demonstrations that combine visual, proprioceptive, and action data. However, collecting such datasets with mobile manipulators is often slowed down by fragmented teleoperation interfaces and manual post-processing workflows. This paper presents an integrated framework for teleoperated multimodal data collection on a Clearpath Dingo-O mobile base equipped with a Kinova Gen3 Lite manipulator and an Intel RealSense RGB-D camera. The framework combines single-controller operation of the base, arm, and recording process with an automated ROS-based pipeline for data capture, image-quality filtering, temporal synchronization, visualization, and export to machine-learning-ready Zarr datasets. We validate the system on a pick-and-place mobile-manipulation task in which the robot transports a bottle between two surfaces. The results show that the unified controller supports complete task execution and recording without external commands, while the data pipeline produces synchronized datasets for short demonstrations and identifies corrupted visual frames. The proposed framework provides a practical basis for producing structured demonstrations for robot-learning research.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人学习系统需要同步的高质量示教数据，这些数据结合视觉、本体感觉和动作数据。然而，使用移动机械臂采集此类数据集常因碎片化的遥操作接口和人工后处理工作流而变慢。本文提出一个集成框架，用于在配备 Kinova Gen3 Lite 机械臂和 Intel RealSense RGB-D 相机的 Clearpath Dingo-O 移动底座上进行遥操作多模态数据采集。该框架将底座、机械臂和记录过程的单控制器操作与基于 ROS 的自动化流水线相结合，用于数据采集、图像质量过滤、时间同步、可视化以及导出为可供机器学习使用的 Zarr 数据集。我们在抓取-放置移动操作任务中验证该系统，其中机器人在两个表面之间运送瓶子。结果表明，统一控制器支持无需外部命令即可完成完整任务执行和记录，而数据流水线可为短示教生成同步数据集，并识别损坏的视觉帧。所提出的框架为机器人学习研究生成结构化示教数据提供了实用基础。

items.title_en: A Hardware-Aware Comprehensive Study of Edge Vision Deployment with A Unified Hardware-Model-Runtime Mapping Framework
items.title_zh: 面向边缘视觉部署的硬件感知综合研究：统一硬件-模型-运行时映射框架
items.abstract_en: The rapid growth of deep learning has driven the deployment of computer vision directly on resource-constrained edge devices. However, the extreme heterogeneity of edge hardware architectures poses major challenges in selecting and designing suitable vision models. This survey bridges the gap between edge hardware constraints, model architectures, and deployment software toolchains. We establish a comprehensive taxonomy classifying edge hardware into three distinct tiers: mid-range devices (GPUs and dedicated NPUs or TPUs), dedicated embedded MPU or SoC processors, and microcontrollers (MCUs). We aggregate and analyze multi-source benchmark results for image classification and object detection across the computing spectrum, spanning from tens of watts down to milliwatt-scale bare-metal MCUs. Based on these empirical findings, we propose a two-tiered hardware-to-model mapping framework that provides concrete model selection matrices across performance priorities (Speed, Balanced, Accuracy) and actionable architectural design principles (peak SRAM budgeting, resolution-first scaling, and algorithm-compiler co-design). Finally, we highlight critical deployment challenges including toolchain fragmentation, operator incompatibility, and Vision Transformer feasibility, and outline promising future research directions in on-device adaptation and sustainable Edge AI.
items.abstract_zh: 深度学习的快速发展推动计算机视觉直接部署在资源受限的边缘设备上。然而，边缘硬件架构的极端异构性给选择和设计合适的视觉模型带来重大挑战。本综述弥合边缘硬件约束、模型架构与部署软件工具链之间的差距。我们建立了一个全面的分类体系，将边缘硬件分为三个不同层级：中端设备（GPU 和专用 NPU 或 TPU）、专用嵌入式 MPU 或 SoC 处理器，以及微控制器（MCU）。我们汇总并分析了跨计算谱系（从数十瓦到毫瓦级裸机 MCU）的图像分类和目标检测多源基准测试结果。基于这些实证发现，我们提出一个双层硬件到模型映射框架，提供跨性能优先级（速度、均衡、精度）的具体模型选择矩阵，以及可操作的架构设计原则（峰值 SRAM 预算、分辨率优先缩放和算法-编译器协同设计）。最后，我们强调关键部署挑战，包括工具链碎片化、算子不兼容和 Vision Transformer 可行性，并概述设备端自适应和可持续边缘 AI 中有前景的未来研究方向。

items.title_en: Cardiac MRI-informed electrocardiography enables biologically grounded cardiomyopathy detection
items.title_zh: 心脏 MRI 信息引导的心电图实现具有生物学依据的心肌病检测
items.abstract_en: Precise myocardial phenotyping at population scale is limited by the cost and accessibility of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), whereas electrocardiography (ECG) is widely available but reflects electrical rather than structural and functional information. Here we develop MyoECG, a cross-modal representation learning framework that distils myocardial structural and functional knowledge from CMR into standard 12-lead ECGs, enabling imaging-informed cardiomyopathy detection and subtype classification from ECGs alone. MyoECG was pretrained on 45,241 paired ECG-CMR examinations from UK Biobank and a tertiary cardiovascular centre, then developed and validated across more than 1.8 million ECGs from seven independent datasets. Across internal and external datasets spanning prevalences of 0.2-54.7%, MyoECG outperformed five pretrained ECG foundation models, with AUROCs of 0.800-0.974 for cardiomyopathy detection. In a multi-reader study of six cardiologists, MyoECG assistance improved mean sensitivity by 0.109 (95% CI, 0.041-0.175; P = 0.009) and specificity by 0.056 (95% CI, 0.004-0.108; P = 0.040). In 41,128 UK Biobank participants, the MyoECG score showed genetic correlations with cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.409) and dilated cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.371), genome-wide associations at four loci, including regions mapped to NFIA and KCNQ1, and associations with 69 circulating proteins related to myocardial stress, cell adhesion, vascular biology and metabolism. The cardiomyopathy correlation attenuated to non-significance after adjustment for 27 measured CMR traits (rg = 0.131; P = 0.143), indicating that the score captures CMR-derived information rather than dataset-specific shortcuts. MyoECG offers a scalable route to CMR-informed cardiomyopathy assessment and a strategy for transferring knowledge from resource-intensive imaging to widely deployable physiological signals.
items.abstract_zh: 在人群规模上进行精确心肌表型分析受到心脏磁共振（CMR）成本和可及性的限制，而心电图（ECG）广泛可用，但反映的是电信息而非结构和功能信息。在此，我们开发了 MyoECG，一种跨模态表示学习框架，将 CMR 中的心肌结构和功能知识蒸馏到标准 12 导联心电图中，从而仅凭心电图实现影像信息引导的心肌病检测和亚型分类。MyoECG 在来自 UK Biobank 和一家三级心血管中心的 45,241 对 ECG-CMR 检查上预训练，随后在来自七个独立数据集的超过 180 万份心电图上开发并验证。在患病率为 0.2–54.7% 的内部和外部数据集中，MyoECG 优于五个预训练心电图基础模型，心肌病检测的 AUROC 为 0.800–0.974。在一项由六名心脏病专家参与的多阅片者研究中，MyoECG 辅助将平均灵敏度提高了 0.109（95% CI，0.041–0.175；P = 0.009），特异度提高了 0.056（95% CI，0.004–0.108；P = 0.040）。在 41,128 名 UK Biobank 参与者中，MyoECG 评分显示与心肌病（rg = 0.409）和扩张型心肌病（rg = 0.371）的遗传相关性，在四个位点具有全基因组关联，包括映射到 NFIA 和 KCNQ1 的区域，并与 69 种与心肌应激、细胞黏附、血管生物学和代谢相关的循环蛋白相关。在校正 27 个测量的 CMR 特征后，心肌病相关性减弱至不显著（rg = 0.131；P = 0.143），表明该评分捕获的是 CMR 衍生信息而非数据集特异性捷径。MyoECG 为 CMR 信息引导的心肌病评估提供了一条可扩展途径，并提供了一种将知识从资源密集型影像转移到可广泛部署的生理信号的策略。

items.title_en: Quantum differential interference contrast microscope
items.title_zh: 量子微分干涉相衬显微镜
items.abstract_en: Optical sensing and imaging of transparent unstained biological and material specimen makes use of optical interference to translate phase shifts into intensity measurements, that are readily available in the optical domain. This is the case of Differential Interference Contrast (DIC) microscopes. However, environmental disturbances such as acoustic vibrations, air currents, temperature shifts, and mechanical drifts cause random phase noise that degrades the precision attainable in the estimation of the unknown phase shift. Although there are tools to compensate for these random phase drifts, such using common path interference techniques or phase stabilization systems, these are not always an option and its introduction is generally at the expense of device simplicity and robustness. Here we introduce a quantum version of Differential Interference Contrast microscopy (qDIC), that makes use of quantum interference for polarization analysis. When compared with standard schemes that make use of coherent light, our approach shows that the transfer of classical DIC microscopy into the quantum domain offers a route towards quantum-enhanced resilience to environmental disturbances, allowing the enhancement of phase sensitivity without sacrificing the simplicity and robustness of the optical setup.
items.abstract_zh: 对透明未染色生物和材料样品的光学传感与成像利用光学干涉将相移转换为强度测量，这些测量在光学域中可直接获得。微分干涉相衬（DIC）显微镜即属于此类。然而，声振动、气流、温度变化和机械漂移等环境扰动会引起随机相位噪声，降低未知相移估计可达到的精度。尽管已有工具可补偿这些随机相位漂移，例如使用共路干涉技术或相位稳定系统，但这些并非总是可选方案，且其引入通常以牺牲设备的简单性和鲁棒性为代价。在此，我们介绍微分干涉相衬显微术的量子版本（qDIC），它利用量子干涉进行偏振分析。与使用相干光的标准方案相比，我们的方法表明，将经典 DIC 显微术转移至量子领域提供了一条通向对环境扰动具有量子增强鲁棒性的途径，能够在不牺牲光学装置简单性和鲁棒性的情况下增强相位灵敏度。

items.title_en: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
items.title_zh: QDA：基于智能体的闭环大语言模型量化设计
items.abstract_en: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model's accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.
items.abstract_zh: 训练后量化是以低成本服务大语言模型的标准方式。然而，最佳量化配方因模型和精度而异。因此，专家必须为每个新模型重新设计配方，这既耗时又往往次优。幸运的是，大语言模型智能体可以通过多轮构建和评估候选来细化配方，从而接管这一设计，使更多轮次带来更好的配方。然而，评估一个量化推理模型需要数十个 GPU 小时，而组合不同代码库中的方法意味着需要手动将每种方法移植到新架构。我们提出 QDA，一个由智能体为每个模型和精度设计配方的系统。为实现快速评估，QDA 在智能体从未见过的推理轨迹上，根据候选输出与原始模型之间的 KL 散度在数分钟内对每个候选评分，并用长生成检查有前景的候选，以捕获重复循环等失败。为实现快速构建，QDA 提供一个公共 PTQ 方法库，这些方法彼此兼容，并与新模型架构兼容。在四个推理模型上，QDA 在 W4A16、W4A8 和 W3A16 下将准确率相较最强公开配方平均提高 0.9、1.4 和 2.2 个百分点，每次搜索使用 64 GPU 小时。在 320B 参数 MoE 模型 GLM-5.3-Flash 上以 NVFP4 W4A4 运行时，它恢复了 FP8 模型 98.3% 的准确率，而最佳供应商检查点为 96.9%。每个 QDA 检查点也可在现有服务内核上运行，无推理开销。我们将发布该库、评估器和测试框架。

items.title_en: Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models
items.title_zh: 面向小语言模型更结构化医学解释的自奖励强化学习
items.abstract_en: Small language models (SLMs) can run on commodity hardware and support privacy-preserving, on-premises clinical deployment, but their medical explanations are often short and poorly structured compared with large language models. Recent supervised approaches such as Meerkat transfer chain-of-thought reasoning into 7B-8B backbones, yet their training objective does not directly target the style or organization of the generated rationales. Building on the instruction-tuned Mistral-7B backbone, we investigate whether a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) step can improve explanation structure without human preference labels.We apply Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with LoRA adaptation to 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts, guided by a simple self-supervised reward that favors longer, lexically diverse, and well-punctuated responses while penalizing very short ones. Training for about 170 PPO steps on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a stable increase in the average reward. Quantitative and qualitative comparisons show that the RL-tuned model produces longer, more organized, multi-point explanations while preserving the underlying medical content.We discuss the promise and the limitations of self-rewarded RL for shaping the style of medical explanations.
items.abstract_zh: 小语言模型（SLM）可在商用硬件上运行，并支持隐私保护的本地临床部署，但与大型语言模型相比，其医学解释通常较短且结构较差。近期的监督方法（如 Meerkat）将思维链推理迁移到 7B-8B 骨干模型中，但其训练目标并不直接针对生成理由的风格或组织。在指令微调的 Mistral-7B 骨干模型基础上，我们研究轻量级强化学习（RL）步骤能否在无人类偏好标签的情况下改进解释结构。我们将带 LoRA 适配的近端策略优化（PPO）应用于 2,000 个源自 Meerkat 的医学提示，并由一个简单的自监督奖励引导，该奖励偏好更长、词汇多样且标点良好的回答，同时惩罚过短的回答。在单块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上训练约 170 个 PPO 步骤，使平均奖励稳定增加。定量和定性比较表明，经 RL 调优的模型产生更长、更有组织、多要点的解释，同时保留其底层医学内容。我们讨论自奖励 RL 在塑造医学解释风格方面的前景和局限。

items.title_en: Assessing Vision-Language Models for Early Prediction of Unsafe Situations in Robotics
items.title_zh: 评估视觉-语言模型在机器人不安全情境早期预测中的表现
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process visual information and textual instructions and, by using their ability to understand and reason about context, are well-suited for predicting robot failures before they occur. However, evidence supporting this remains limited. To address this, we present an empirical evaluation of VLMs for predicting robot failures. In particular, we experiment with Qwen, InternVL, and LLaVA-OneVision across three robotic case studies (HuRoN, Pal Robotics, and CrowdBot), analyzing both video and odometry data for early failure warning (i.e., before an unsafe situation occurs). Specifically, we evaluate their performance in classifying situations as safe, potentially unsafe, and unsafe, together with uncertainty quantified using various metrics, and study the relationship between uncertainty and performance. Our results showed that Qwen provides the strongest overall classification and prediction-reliability performance, while InternVL shows stronger early-warning capability in several configurations. The results further show that the effect of robot-state information and temporal history depends on the model and evaluation objective. Overall, our findings indicate that general-purpose VLMs can support early robot-safety monitoring, but the most suitable configuration depends on whether the priority is accurate assessment of safety-state, reliable confidence and uncertainty, or timely warning before unsafe events.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）处理视觉信息和文本指令，并利用其理解和推理上下文的能力，适合在机器人故障发生前进行预测。然而，支持这一点的证据仍然有限。为此，我们提出对 VLM 预测机器人故障的实证评估。具体而言，我们在三个机器人案例研究（HuRoN、Pal Robotics 和 CrowdBot）中实验 Qwen、InternVL 和 LLaVA-OneVision，分析视频和里程计数据以进行早期故障预警（即在不安全情境发生之前）。我们评估其将情境分类为安全、潜在不安全和不安全的表现，以及使用多种度量量化的不确定性，并研究不确定性与性能之间的关系。我们的结果表明，Qwen 提供了最强的整体分类和预测可靠性表现，而 InternVL 在若干配置中表现出更强的预警能力。结果进一步表明，机器人状态信息和时序历史的影响取决于模型和评估目标。总体而言，我们的发现表明，通用 VLM 可以支持早期机器人安全监控，但最合适的配置取决于优先事项是准确评估安全状态、可靠的置信度和不确定性，还是在不安全事件发生前及时预警。

items.title_en: Spool: Low-Latency Streaming Inference for Hybrid Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: Spool：面向混合视觉语言模型的低延迟流式推理
items.abstract_en: Applications such as visual accessibility agents and robotics require answering questions about recent video content promptly, over a bounded window of past frames (e.g., the last two minutes). Hybrid vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave attention with linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), are attractive for this setting, but maintaining a sliding window is expensive. The reason is that recurrent layers combine all past frames into a shared state, so expiring old frames normally requires re-running the entire window through the model. We observe that the recurrent update is affine in the state with input-dependent coefficients, so the effect of each frame can be captured as a transformation that composes associatively. We present Spool, a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations and composes them efficiently as the window advances, removing expired frames from each recurrent layer's state without replaying frames through the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; as with key-value eviction in attention, expired frames can retain residual influence through the cached inputs computed by earlier layers. We design a dedicated data structure and GPU kernels to achieve low caching and composition overhead. Across five open-source hybrid VLMs and four video reasoning benchmarks, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model-benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of $6.6\times$ over the faster of two recent vLLM baselines, while improving accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average.
items.abstract_zh: 诸如视觉辅助智能体和机器人等应用需要及时回答关于近期视频内容的问题，且仅基于过去帧的有界窗口（例如最近两分钟）。混合视觉语言模型（VLM）将注意力与线性循环层（如 Gated DeltaNet，GDN）交错，在此场景中具有吸引力，但维护滑动窗口代价高昂。原因在于循环层将所有过去的帧合并为一个共享状态，因此通常需要将整个窗口重新通过模型运行才能让旧帧过期。我们观察到，循环更新在状态上是仿射的，且系数依赖于输入，因此每一帧的影响可以捕获为一种可结合复合的变换。我们提出 Spool，一个免训练框架，它缓存每帧的状态变换，并在窗口推进时高效地复合这些变换，从而从每个循环层的状态中移除过期帧，而无需通过主干重放帧。移除在每个层内是精确的；与注意力中的键值驱逐一样，过期帧仍可能通过先前层计算的缓存输入保留残余影响。我们设计了专用数据结构和 GPU 内核，以实现低缓存和复合开销。在五个开源混合 VLM 和四个视频推理基准上，Spool 在所有 20 项模型-基准测试中实现了最低的 p95 首令牌时间，相较于两个近期 vLLM 基线中较快的那个，几何平均降低 6.6 倍，同时平均准确率提高 2.3 个百分点。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Traditional and Learning-Based Reference-Free Compressors for Long-Read Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 长读长测序数据中传统与基于学习的无参考压缩器的基准测试
items.abstract_en: Long-read sequencing technologies generate large volumes of data, creating substantial storage and transmission demands. Although reference-based compressors can achieve high compression, their reliance on an appropriate reference genome limits their use. We present LRCBench, a benchmark and survey of reference-free lossless compressors for long-read sequencing data. We review traditional and learning-based general-purpose and sequencing-specific methods, then evaluate 35 compressors on 16 real-world datasets from Oxford Nanopore and PacBio platforms. We compare compression ratio, storage savings, runtime, peak memory use, and robustness across datasets. Learning-based compressors are evaluated on six MinION datasets because of their high computational costs. CoLoRd achieves the best overall compression ratios in our experiments, while other methods offer trade-offs in speed, memory use, and robustness. We also examine multithreaded speedup and discuss future directions in parallel acceleration, privacy protection, adaptive parameter tuning, and hardware-algorithm co-design.
items.abstract_zh: 长读长测序技术产生大量数据，带来巨大的存储和传输需求。尽管基于参考的压缩器可以实现高压缩率，但其对合适参考基因组的依赖限制了其使用。我们提出 LRCBench，一个针对长读长测序数据的无参考无损压缩器的基准测试与综述。我们回顾传统和基于学习的通用及测序专用方法，然后在来自 Oxford Nanopore 和 PacBio 平台的 16 个真实数据集上评估 35 个压缩器。我们比较压缩比、存储节省、运行时间、峰值内存使用以及跨数据集的鲁棒性。由于计算成本高，基于学习的压缩器在六个 MinION 数据集上评估。在我们的实验中，CoLoRd 实现了最佳的整体压缩比，而其他方法在速度、内存使用和鲁棒性方面提供权衡。我们还考察了多线程加速，并讨论了并行加速、隐私保护、自适应参数调优以及硬件-算法协同设计等未来方向。

items.title_en: Targeted material doping to enable the formation and coherent propagation of Laser Induced Periodic Surface Structures (LIPSS): the ZnO paradigm
items.title_zh: 靶向材料掺杂以实现激光诱导周期表面结构（LIPSS）的形成与相干传播：ZnO 范式
items.abstract_en: This work explores how the initial free carrier density governs the formation and coherent propagation of Low Spatial Frequency Laser-Induced Periodic Surface Structures (LSF-LIPSS). As a paradigm we have analyzed the behavior of ad-hoc-doped ZnO films. ZnO is a multifunctional Transparent Conducting Oxide (TCO) with many scientific and technologic uses including applications in biomedicine, photonics, sensing or photocatalysis. Many of them would benefit from the use of large area, electrically anisotropic surfaces. By introducing small amounts of Yb3+ as donor dopant in ZnO films grown by Pulse Laser Deposition (PLD), we have substantially improved its carrier density at room temperature (RT) and its electrical conductivity while preserving the functional properties of pure ZnO. For RT carrier densities ne > 1019 cm-3, coherent propagation of LSF-LIPSS has been successfully achieved upon irradiation with 350 fs laser pulses at 1030 nm at high repetition rate (500 kHz) and for laser scanning speeds well above 1 m/s. However, the ablation mechanism (ZnO sublimation at the LIPSS valleys) and the large melting temperature of ZnO, make the thermal conductivity of the substrate, the film thickness and the irradiation pulse duration to play a crucial role in determining the morphology of the LSF-LIPPS propagated over large areas, especially in avoiding film cracking. The results achieved upon optimization fully confirm the role of free carrier density in the large-scale propagation of high quality LSF-LIPSS in doped ZnO and enable using these structures to easily generate large electrical anisotropies over macroscopic regions with conductivities along the LIPSS several times larger than transversally.
items.abstract_zh: 本工作探讨初始自由载流子密度如何控制低空间频率激光诱导周期表面结构（LSF-LIPSS）的形成与相干传播。作为范式，我们分析了定制掺杂 ZnO 薄膜的行为。ZnO 是一种多功能透明导电氧化物（TCO），具有许多科学和技术用途，包括在生物医学、光子学、传感或光催化中的应用。其中许多应用将受益于使用大面积、电各向异性的表面。通过在脉冲激光沉积（PLD）生长的 ZnO 薄膜中引入少量 Yb3+ 作为施主掺杂剂，我们显著提高了其在室温（RT）下的载流子密度和电导率，同时保留了纯 ZnO 的功能特性。对于室温载流子密度 ne > 10^19 cm^-3，在 1030 nm、350 fs 激光脉冲、高重复频率（500 kHz）以及远高于 1 m/s 的激光扫描速度照射下，已成功实现 LSF-LIPSS 的相干传播。然而，烧蚀机制（LIPSS 谷处的 ZnO 升华）和 ZnO 的高熔化温度，使得衬底热导率、薄膜厚度和照射脉冲持续时间在决定大面积传播的 LSF-LIPSS 形貌方面发挥关键作用，尤其是在避免薄膜开裂方面。优化后取得的结果充分证实了自由载流子密度在掺杂 ZnO 中高质量 LSF-LIPSS 大规模传播中的作用，并使这些结构能够容易地在宏观区域上产生大的电各向异性，沿 LIPSS 方向的电导率比横向大数倍。

items.title_en: Auditing black-box clinical prediction models with a large language model through queries alone: a blinded test with planted flaws
items.title_zh: 仅通过查询使用大语言模型审计黑盒临床预测模型：带有植入缺陷的盲法测试
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are used to explain clinical prediction models, on the promise that they can say what a model computes, find its faults and even reveal new knowledge in it. We tested the three promises where the answers could be checked. From the International Stroke Trial we trained four kinds of model (logistic regression, explainable boosting machine, gradient-boosted trees, neural network) for two outcomes on patients randomised earlier, planted one flaw in each of 24 copies (an under-predicted subgroup, a reversed risk factor or an implausible step) and mixed them with the 8 clean models. GPT-6 Astra audited each model three times, blind, through a tool that only returned the model's predictions; the judging rules were committed before any run and applied by program. Its surrogate models, with a median of 128 terms, reproduced the audited models' log-odds with a mean $R^2$ of 0.976 (0.959 for an additive surrogate of 42 terms fitted by an analyst). It found the planted flaw in 69 of 72 runs (96%; 95% CI 80% to 99%); a script written for the purpose found all 24. It also reported many more problems: 60% of 1,089 checkable reports failed the pre-specified check against the model's average behaviour; post hoc, most of these were real but small steps, and 15% of the checkable reports were not found in the model. Of 601 unexpected relationships it read out of the clean models, 11% held in patients randomised later (random pairs 6%; a regression scan's shorter list of its strongest candidates, 28%); after a check on the training data, 33% against 30%. With query access alone, an LLM can describe a black-box model faithfully and find nearly every planted flaw, as a purpose-written script also did; its reports of problems must be checked on the model and its discoveries on data.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）被用于解释临床预测模型，其承诺是它们能说明模型计算什么、发现其缺陷，甚至揭示其中的新知识。我们在答案可核查的情况下测试了这三项承诺。基于国际卒中试验，我们针对较早随机化的患者、两个结局训练了四类模型（逻辑回归、可解释提升机、梯度提升树、神经网络），在 24 个副本中各植入一个缺陷（一个被低估的亚组、一个方向颠倒的风险因素或一个不合理的步骤），并将它们与 8 个干净模型混合。GPT-6 Astra 通过一个仅返回模型预测的工具，对每个模型盲法审计三次；评判规则在任何运行之前确定，并由程序应用。其代理模型中位项数为 128，以平均 R^2 为 0.976 复现了被审计模型的对数几率（由分析师拟合的 42 项加性代理模型为 0.959）。它在 72 次运行中的 69 次发现了植入缺陷（96%；95% CI 80% 至 99%）；为此目的编写的脚本找到了全部 24 个。它还报告了更多问题：1,089 份可核查报告中有 60% 未通过针对模型平均行为的预设检查；事后看，其中大多数是真实但较小的步骤，并且 15% 的可核查报告在模型中未找到。在它从干净模型中读出的 601 个意外关系中，11% 在较晚随机化的患者中成立（随机配对为 6%；回归扫描其最强候选的较短列表为 28%）；在对训练数据进行检查后，分别为 33% 和 30%。仅凭查询访问，LLM 就能忠实描述黑盒模型，并发现几乎每一个植入缺陷，正如专门编写的脚本也能做到的那样；其问题报告必须在模型上核查，其发现必须在数据上核查。

items.title_en: Objective-Specialized Residual Streams in Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
items.title_zh: 流形约束超连接中的目标专用残差流
items.abstract_en: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extend a Transformer's residual stream into multiple parallel streams with learned cross-stream connections. Prior work trains all streams toward a shared objective. We instead study whether assigning distinct learning objectives to different streams can improve task performance and induce objective-specific specialization. Using complementary lexical (sparse) and semantic (dense) retrieval objectives as a test case, we find that objective-specialized mHC consistently outperforms a non-specialized mHC model across the full sparse--dense fusion range, for both two- and four-stream models and at two model scales. We then examine how specialization changes the model internally using probes of stream representations, residual mixing, objective-specific gradient flow, and read/write gates. The specialized and non-specialized models behave similarly through most of the network but diverge in the final layers: the specialized model develops increasingly objective-specific gradient flow, distinct read/write routing patterns, and reduced cross-stream mixing, and streams assigned to different objectives become increasingly dissimilar while those trained toward the same objective remain highly similar. Fixing the residual mixing to the identity leaves the specialization benefit intact, indicating that the benefit stems from objective-specific read/write routing rather than learned cross-stream mixing. These results show that assigning distinct objectives to mHC streams can improve multi-objective retrieval while inducing structured, depth-dependent specialization in the residual computation.
items.abstract_zh: 流形约束超连接（mHC）将 Transformer 的残差流扩展为多个并行流，并具有学习到的跨流连接。先前工作将所有流训练向共享目标。我们转而研究为不同流分配不同的学习目标是否能提高任务性能并诱导目标特定的专业化。使用互补的词汇（稀疏）和语义（稠密）检索目标作为测试案例，我们发现目标专用 mHC 在整个稀疏--稠密融合范围内、对于双流和四流模型以及两种模型规模，均持续优于非专用 mHC 模型。然后，我们通过探测流表示、残差混合、目标特定梯度流以及读/写门，考察专业化如何在内部改变模型。专用模型和非专用模型在网络的大部分中表现相似，但在最后几层出现分歧：专用模型发展出日益目标特定的梯度流、不同的读/写路由模式，并减少跨流混合，且分配给不同目标的流变得越来越不相似，而训练向同一目标的流保持高度相似。将残差混合固定为单位映射后，专业化收益保持不变，表明该收益源于目标特定的读/写路由，而非学习到的跨流混合。这些结果表明，为 mHC 流分配不同目标可以改善多目标检索，同时在残差计算中诱导结构化的、深度依赖的专业化。

items.title_en: A Hierarchical Onboard Vision-Language-Navigation Framework for Aerial Robots in Complex Environments
items.title_zh: 复杂环境中空中机器人的分层机载视觉-语言-导航框架
items.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are expected to achieve semantic reasoning, intelligent decision-making, and long-horizon navigation under strict onboard constraints. While recent foundation-model-driven approaches have shown promising progress toward this goal, existing methods remain limited by challenges in 3D data availability, trajectory feasibility, long-horizon reasoning, and computational efficiency in complex environments. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLN-AR, a hierarchical vision-language-navigation (VLN) framework for aerial robots. VLN-AR decouples multimodal reasoning and low-level control, enabling structured prediction of 3D pose commands and navigation intentions that are translated into dynamically feasible actions. To mitigate data scarcity and domain gaps, we introduce a fully automated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based pipeline to generate scalable photorealistic UAV navigation data. A progressive three-stage training strategy further enhances grounding, scene reasoning, and complex navigation. In addition, a lightweight cognitive agent improves long-horizon reasoning via memory-aware task decomposition. Finally, we design onboard optimization techniques, including token sparsification and model lightweighting, achieving 7.1x-9.4x speedup while maintaining high navigation performance on resource-limited UAV platforms. Experiments show great improvements over existing methods in both simulation and real-world UAV navigation. Project website: https://wyz000.github.io/VLN-AR/
items.abstract_zh: 无人机（UAV）被期望在严格的机载约束下实现语义推理、智能决策和长时程导航。尽管近期基础模型驱动的方法在实现这一目标方面显示出有希望的进展，但现有方法仍受限于复杂环境中 3D 数据可用性、轨迹可行性、长时程推理和计算效率方面的挑战。为弥合这些差距，我们提出 VLN-AR，一种用于空中机器人的分层视觉-语言-导航（VLN）框架。VLN-AR 将多模态推理与低层控制解耦，能够结构化预测 3D 姿态指令和导航意图，并将其转化为动态可行的动作。为缓解数据稀缺和领域差距，我们引入一个全自动的基于 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）的流水线，以生成可扩展的照片级真实 UAV 导航数据。渐进式三阶段训练策略进一步增强基础定位、场景推理和复杂导航。此外，一个轻量级认知智能体通过记忆感知的任务分解改善长时程推理。最后，我们设计了机载优化技术，包括 token 稀疏化和模型轻量化，在资源受限的 UAV 平台上实现 7.1 倍至 9.4 倍加速，同时保持高导航性能。实验表明，在仿真和真实世界 UAV 导航中均较现有方法有大幅提升。项目网站：https://wyz000.github.io/VLN-AR/

items.title_en: TRIDENT: Efficient Triple-Task Learning of Dehazing, Depth, and Uncertainty Estimation for Underwater 3-D Robot Visual Perception
items.title_zh: TRIDENT：面向水下三维机器人视觉感知的去雾、深度与不确定性估计高效三任务学习
items.abstract_en: Underwater visual systems often suffer from blurry textures and low color contrast due to the inevitable light propagation. These issues can significantly degrade the perception of stable robotic operations. In this paper, we introduce a novel learning-based sensing system that tackles the multidimensional vision tasks in underwater; concretely, we deal with image enhancement, depth estimation, and uncertainty for 3-D visual systems. Also, we propose a TRIDENT model in a fast and lightweight manner; TRIDENT consists of three parallelized decoders and one backbone structure for efficient feature sharing. In addition, it is designed to be trained to express complex parameterization. In experimental evaluation on several standard datasets, we demonstrate that TRIDENT significantly outperforms other existing methods on image enhancement and depth estimation. Despite performing three tasks, our model has better efficiency than the others for both memory size and inference time. Finally, our joint learning approach demonstrates robustness in feature matching and seamlessly extends from 2-D to 3-D vision tasks. Supplements are available at https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home
items.abstract_zh: 由于不可避免的光传播，水下视觉系统常常出现纹理模糊和颜色对比度低的问题。这些问题会显著降低稳定机器人操作的感知能力。本文中，我们介绍一种新颖的基于学习的传感系统，用于处理水下的多维视觉任务；具体而言，我们处理三维视觉系统的图像增强、深度估计和不确定性。此外，我们以快速且轻量的方式提出TRIDENT模型；TRIDENT由三个并行化解码器和一个主干结构组成，以实现高效的特征共享。此外，它被设计为经过训练以表达复杂参数化。在若干标准数据集上的实验评估中，我们证明TRIDENT在图像增强和深度估计上显著优于其他现有方法。尽管执行三个任务，我们的模型在内存大小和推理时间方面均比其他方法具有更好的效率。最后，我们的联合学习方法在特征匹配中表现出鲁棒性，并从二维无缝扩展到三维视觉任务。补充材料见 https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home

items.title_en: STORM: A Lightweight Structure-Free Model for Binding Affinity Prediction
items.title_zh: STORM：一种用于结合亲和力预测的轻量级无结构模型
items.abstract_en: Accurately predicting a small molecule's binding affinity to a protein, a critical task in drug discovery, remains challenging. Physics-based approaches like free-energy perturbation (FEP) have very high computational costs and require expert setup. Recent machine learning--based cofolding models have reported accuracy approaching that of FEP---and at least one of them, Boltz-2, has already been widely adopted for affinity prediction---but they remain expensive for large computational screens and even more expensive for retraining on newly collected experimental data. To address these challenges, we introduce STORM: Similarity Transfer from Observed Reference Molecules. STORM is a fast, simple machine learning model that ensembles many small model fusions of diverse protein and molecule representations for binding affinity prediction. Trained on the same data, STORM matches or exceeds the accuracy of Boltz-2 on multiple evaluation datasets, while delivering a speed improvement of over five orders of magnitude for both inference and training. Our results also suggest opportunities to substantially improve affinity prediction accuracy by integrating historical experimental affinity data with structural and biophysical information.
items.abstract_zh: 准确预测小分子与蛋白质的结合亲和力是药物发现中的关键任务，仍然具有挑战性。基于物理的方法（如自由能扰动，FEP）计算成本非常高，且需要专家设置。近期基于机器学习的共折叠模型报告的精度已接近FEP——其中至少一个模型Boltz-2已被广泛用于亲和力预测——但它们对于大规模计算筛选仍然昂贵，并且在新收集的实验数据上重新训练甚至更昂贵。为应对这些挑战，我们提出STORM：从观测参考分子进行相似性迁移（Similarity Transfer from Observed Reference Molecules）。STORM是一种快速、简单的机器学习模型，它集成许多由多样化蛋白质和分子表示构成的小模型融合，用于结合亲和力预测。在相同数据上训练，STORM在多个评估数据集上达到或超过Boltz-2的精度，同时在推理和训练上均带来超过五个数量级的速度提升。我们的结果还表明，通过将历史实验亲和力数据与结构和生物物理信息相结合，有机会大幅提高亲和力预测精度。

items.title_en: Zernike-efficient phase contrast with a scanned electron probe
items.title_zh: 使用扫描电子探针的Zernike高效相位衬度
items.abstract_en: For weak-phase objects, scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) with a far-field detector transfers at most half of the phase information per electron that Zernike phase-contrast (ZPC) conventional transmission electron microscopy (CTEM) achieves. We propose APEX (Apex Phase-plate EXit-wave imaging), a scanned-probe mode that combines a defocused probe, a $π/2$ phase element in a magnified image of the probe crossover, and in-focus image-plane detection at each scan position. It applies the generalized Zernike framework of Dwyer and Paganin to a scanned probe. In a linear model of a thin weak-phase object with an ideal phase dot, APEX transfers nearly the full Zernike Fisher information over a wide band, substantially more than diffraction-plane four-dimensional STEM (4D-STEM). In idealized simulations of myoglobin in vitreous ice at a cryo-EM dose (elastic scattering only, no chromatic aberration, full coherence), ideal-dot APEX at a probe defocus of 1 $μ$m reconstructs the phase more accurately than defocused 4D-STEM ptychography with one untuned probe setting. At a defocus of about 25 $μ$m, a crossed laser phase plate (XLPP) acts as the $π/2$ element, and APEX of a periodic specimen cell comes close to CTEM with the same plate. In two dimensions, this mode is equivalent to laser phase-plate CTEM of a small, scanned area. A single simulated APEX scan with the XLPP also separates two myoglobin phase screens 150 nm apart in vacuum, at known depths, which is not possible with one ZPC CTEM exposure.
items.abstract_zh: 对于弱相位物体，使用远场探测器的扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）每个电子传递的相位信息至多是Zernike相位衬度（ZPC）常规透射电子显微镜（CTEM）所实现的一半。我们提出APEX（Apex Phase-plate EXit-wave imaging），一种扫描探针模式，它结合了离焦探针、探针交叉点放大图像中的π/2相位元件，以及每个扫描位置处的聚焦像面探测。它将Dwyer和Paganin的广义Zernike框架应用于扫描探针。在具有理想相位点的薄弱相位物体的线性模型中，APEX在宽频带上传递了几乎全部Zernike Fisher信息，大幅多于衍射面四维STEM（4D-STEM）。在冷冻电镜剂量下（仅弹性散射、无色差、完全相干）对玻璃态冰中肌红蛋白的理想化模拟中，在1 μm探针离焦下，理想点APEX比采用一个未调谐探针设置的离焦4D-STEM叠层成像更准确地重建相位。在约25 μm离焦下，交叉激光相位板（XLPP）充当π/2元件，对周期性样品池的APEX接近使用相同板的CTEM。在二维中，该模式等价于对小扫描区域的激光相位板CTEM。使用XLPP的单次模拟APEX扫描还能在真空中、已知深度下分离相距150 nm的两个肌红蛋白相位屏，而单次ZPC CTEM曝光无法做到。

items.title_en: Prognosis Without Prediction: The Intrinsic Geometry of Survival
items.title_zh: 无预测的预后：生存的内在几何
items.abstract_en: Modeling systemic failure in high-dimensional environments is fundamentally limited by supervised algorithms that attempt to predict sparse, noisy or censored endpoints. To break this reliance on explicit outcome regression, we engineered the Self-Organizing Survival Manifolds (SOSM) framework, a deep learning architecture that decouples unsupervised representation learning from survival labels and treats time-to-event progression as an emergent geometric property. The system projects heterogeneous multi-omics arrays into a unified latent space governed by a pseudotime-weighted, curvature-minimizing graph Laplacian, organizing patient trajectories along low-dissipation geodesic flows. To validate the framework, we applied this architecture to a 184-patient clear cell renal cell carcinoma multi-omics cohort. Across a deterministic 5-fold cross-validation pipeline, SOSM achieved a mean Concordance Index of $0.768 \pm 0.068$, while out-of-fold risk stratification yielded significant survival divergence (log-rank $p < 0.001$) accompanied by a 14.7% increase in local manifold dissipation among high-risk patients. Furthermore, interrogating the network's encoder weights confirmed that the model autonomously recovered canonical metabolic and microenvironmental drivers of disease progression without supervised feature selection. By demonstrating that systemic failure can be mapped as a geometric phase transition, SOSM establishes a generalizable computational engine for prognostic modeling across biological, industrial and financial complex systems.
items.abstract_zh: 对高维环境中的系统性失效进行建模，从根本上受限于试图预测稀疏、噪声或删失终点的监督算法。为打破对显式结局回归的依赖，我们设计了自组织生存流形（SOSM）框架，这是一种深度学习架构，它将无监督表示学习与生存标签解耦，并将事件时间进展视为一种涌现的几何性质。该系统将异质多组学阵列投影到由伪时间加权、曲率最小化的图拉普拉斯支配的统一潜在空间中，沿低耗散测地流组织患者轨迹。为验证该框架，我们将此架构应用于一个184例患者的透明细胞肾细胞癌多组学队列。在确定性五折交叉验证流程中，SOSM达到平均一致性指数0.768 ± 0.068，同时折外风险分层产生了显著的生存差异（log-rank p < 0.001），并伴随高风险患者局部流形耗散增加14.7%。此外，检查网络编码器权重证实，该模型在无监督特征选择的情况下自主恢复了疾病进展的典型代谢和微环境驱动因素。通过证明系统性失效可以映射为几何相变，SOSM为跨生物、工业和金融复杂系统的预后建模建立了一个可推广的计算引擎。

items.title_en: MECI: Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction for Multimodal Entity Linking
items.title_zh: MECI：面向多模态实体链接的多元素协同交互
items.abstract_en: Multimodal Entity Linking (MEL) aims to disambiguate mentions in multimodal contexts by grounding them to specific entities in a knowledge base. A pivotal challenge in MEL is capturing multi-level correspondences: the semantic consistency between mention-entity pairs and the complementary correlations across modalities. However, existing methods often suffer from element dominance due to their reliance on coupled interactions or coarse global aggregations. In response, we propose the Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction (MECI) framework. First, to capture multi-element mention-entity correspondences, we develop a Multi-view Experts Network that leverages a "divide-and-conquer" strategy for decoupled feature learning to mitigate element dominance, supported by a KL-guided routing mechanism that governs expert specialization and collaboration. Furthermore, to model cross-modal complementary correlations, we propose a Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Module, where a dynamic modality-aware weighting network refines interactions across hierarchical semantic levels, thereby integrating multi-granular evidence to counteract element dominance. Finally, we incorporate a generative semantic refinement stage that utilizes large language models for zero-shot re-ranking. Extensive experiments on WikiDiverse, RichpediaMEL, and WikiMEL show that MECI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, improving Hits@1 by 1.95%, 7.30%, and 2.31%, respectively.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态实体链接（MEL）旨在通过将多模态上下文中的提及链接到知识库中的特定实体来对其进行消歧。MEL中的一个关键挑战是捕获多级对应关系：提及-实体对之间的语义一致性以及跨模态的互补相关性。然而，现有方法常常由于依赖耦合交互或粗粒度全局聚合而遭受元素主导问题。为此，我们提出多元素协同交互（MECI）框架。首先，为捕获多元素提及-实体对应关系，我们开发了一个多视图专家网络，它利用“分而治之”策略进行解耦特征学习以缓解元素主导，并由一个KL引导的路由机制支持，该机制管理专家专门化与协作。此外，为建模跨模态互补相关性，我们提出了一个分层多模态交互模块，其中动态模态感知加权网络细化跨分层语义级别的交互，从而整合多粒度证据以抵消元素主导。最后，我们加入一个生成式语义细化阶段，利用大语言模型进行零样本重排序。在WikiDiverse、RichpediaMEL和WikiMEL上的大量实验表明，MECI始终优于最先进的基线，Hits@1分别提升1.95%、7.30%和2.31%。

items.title_en: LaST1.0: A Unified Latent World-Action Model with Control-Centric SpatioTemporal Reasoning
items.title_zh: LaST1.0：一种具有以控制为中心的时空推理的统一潜在世界-动作模型
items.abstract_en: World-Action Models couple action learning with future prediction, enabling robotic policies to capture environmental dynamics for robust control. However, prevailing methods take a reconstruction-oriented approach to model future videos, allocating substantial capacity to appearance details that are incidental to control. In this work, we reformulate world modeling for manipulation as control-centric future prediction in latent space, and present LaST1.0, a unified latent World-Action Model. Rather than modeling an observation-complete video future, LaST1.0 predicts compact, geometry-aware latent targets derived from future wrist views, focusing the supervision on the evolving robot-object interactions required for fine-grained manipulation. To better support this control-centric paradigm, LaST1.0 revisits the visual input interface and attention mechanism of its unified architecture. It adopts a vision-encoder-free design with a lightweight patch embedder, exposing fine-grained visual cues directly to the backbone, and introduces LaST-Attention for structured spatiotemporal interactions across modalities. Evaluations across two robot embodiments, five challenging manipulation tasks, and three simulation benchmarks---RLBench, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus---demonstrate that LaST1.0 achieves state-of-the-art success rates and generalizes to novel scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of control-centric latent world modeling for robust manipulation.
items.abstract_zh: 世界-动作模型将动作学习与未来预测耦合，使机器人策略能够捕获环境动态以实现鲁棒控制。然而，主流方法采用面向重建的方法来建模未来视频，将大量容量分配给与控制无关的外观细节。在这项工作中，我们将操作的世界建模重新表述为潜在空间中以控制为中心的未来预测，并提出LaST1.0，一种统一潜在世界-动作模型。LaST1.0不是对观测完整的视频未来进行建模，而是预测从未来腕部视角导出的紧凑、几何感知潜在目标，将监督集中在细粒度操作所需的不断演化的机器人-物体交互上。为更好地支持这种以控制为中心的范式，LaST1.0重新审视其统一架构的视觉输入接口和注意力机制。它采用无视觉编码器设计，配备轻量级图像块嵌入器，将细粒度视觉线索直接暴露给主干，并引入LaST-Attention以实现跨模态的结构化时空交互。在两个机器人实施例、五个具有挑战性的操作任务和三个仿真基准——RLBench、LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus——上的评估表明，LaST1.0取得了最先进的成功率，并能泛化到新场景。这些结果证明了以控制为中心的潜在世界建模对于鲁棒操作的有效性。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集合优化底层连续体积场景函数，在复杂场景的新视角合成方面取得最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5D坐标（空间位置$(x,y,z)$和观察方向$(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和视角相关的发射辐射。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示唯一需要的输入是一组具有已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视角，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: OmniT2I: a unified table-to-image framework for survival prediction and cross-modal inference with incomplete multimodal cancer data
items.title_zh: OmniT2I：一个统一的表格到图像框架，用于不完整多模态癌症数据的生存预测与跨模态推断
items.abstract_en: Molecular profiles and histopathology provide complementary information about cancer prognosis, but these data are often incomplete for individual patients. Here we present OmniT2I, a table-to-image framework for survival prediction and cross-modal inference from incomplete multimodal cancer data. Each molecular profile was converted into a three-channel image representation with correlation-based feature placement. OmniT2I combines available molecular and histopathology embeddings through availability-aware fusion and predicts missing modalities from those observed. Across 10,373 patients with 32 cancer types, the C-index was 0.631 within cancer types and 0.783 with all cancers pooled (0.660 and 0.787 in 5,605 patients with all five modalities). A single model handled all 31 modality combinations and, compared with nine survival methods trained separately for each, achieved higher C-indices in 240 of 279 pooled and 226 of 279 within-cancer comparisons. Adding predictions of withheld modalities to observed inputs improved pooled C-indices in all 180 pairings of observed and withheld modality sets and within-cancer C-indices in 164. Adding measured histopathology to RNA produced the largest within-cancer C-index gain among the four additional modalities evaluated, whereas adding copy number variation reduced it. In seven external cohorts, frozen RNA-only C-indices differed from test performance in the corresponding cancer type in TCGA by a median of -0.003 (range, -0.092 to +0.079). OmniT2I enables prognostic modeling with incomplete multimodal data.
items.abstract_zh: 分子谱和组织病理学提供关于癌症预后的互补信息，但这些数据对个体患者而言往往不完整。在此，我们提出OmniT2I，一个表格到图像框架，用于从不完整多模态癌症数据进行生存预测和跨模态推断。每个分子谱被转换为具有基于相关性的特征放置的三通道图像表示。OmniT2I通过可用性感知融合结合可用的分子和组织病理学嵌入，并从已观察模态预测缺失模态。在涵盖32种癌症类型的10,373名患者中，癌种内C-index为0.631，所有癌症合并时为0.783（在拥有全部五种模态的5,605名患者中分别为0.660和0.787）。单个模型处理了全部31种模态组合，并且与分别针对每种组合训练的九种生存方法相比，在279个合并比较中的240个和279个癌种内比较中的226个取得更高的C-index。将保留模态的预测加入已观察输入，在所有180个已观察与保留模态集合配对中提高了合并C-index，并在164个配对中提高了癌种内C-index。在评估的四种附加模态中，将测得的组织病理学加入RNA在癌种内C-index增益最大，而加入拷贝数变异则使其降低。在七个外部队列中，仅RNA的冻结C-index与TCGA中相应癌症类型的测试性能相比，中位差异为-0.003（范围，-0.092至+0.079）。OmniT2I使得在不完整多模态数据下进行预后建模成为可能。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Observation of temporal routing of topological edge states
items.title_zh: 拓扑边缘态时间路由的观测
items.abstract_en: The switching or routing of topological edge states is crucial for disorder-immune state transfer. Previous experimental observations have primarily relied on optical waveguide arrays that treat the spatial coordinate as an equivalent temporal dimension. However, direct experimental observation of the routing dynamics of topological edge states in physical time remains challenging. Here, we report the experimental observation of temporal routing of topological edge states. By constructing a lattice composed of two coupled nonlinear Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chains, the topological edge states exhibit temporal routing behavior controlled by nonlinearity. As the excitation voltage increases from the linear regime, we observe that the voltage intensity distribution transitions from periodic interchain exchange to slowed interchain exchange and ultimately to localization with strongly suppressed interchain exchange, thereby validating the phenomenon of temporal routing. These dynamics are experimentally observed within a finite time window limited by circuit dissipation. Our findings provide valuable insights into the temporal manipulation of topological edge states.
items.abstract_zh: 拓扑边缘态的切换或路由对于免疫无序的状态传输至关重要。先前的实验观测主要依赖于将空间坐标视为等效时间维度的光波导阵列。然而，在物理时间中直接实验观测拓扑边缘态的路由动力学仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们报道拓扑边缘态时间路由的实验观测。通过构建由两条耦合非线性Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链组成的晶格，拓扑边缘态表现出由非线性控制的时间路由行为。随着激发电压从线性区域增加，我们观察到电压强度分布从周期性链间交换转变为减慢的链间交换，并最终转变为链间交换被强烈抑制的局域化，从而验证了时间路由现象。这些动力学是在受电路耗散限制的有限时间窗口内实验观测到的。我们的发现为拓扑边缘态的时间操控提供了有价值的见解。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Towards Deep Learning-Based Linear Assignment Problem Solvers for Multi-Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向多目标跟踪的基于深度学习的线性分配问题求解器
items.abstract_en: This paper proposes and evaluates deep learning (DL)-based linear assignment problem (LAP) solvers as a replacement for the classical Hungarian algorithm in multi-object tracking (MOT) systems. Three representative neural models are studied, namely a convolutional network (CNN), a graph neural network (GNN), and the graph-based linear assignment network (GLAN). A cost-matrix embedding is introduced so that a single model operates on cost matrices of any size, as required in MOT where the number of objects varies over time, without training a separate model for each input shape. Extensive simulations show that the embedding improves the accuracy of the neural solvers (i.e., CNN and GNN), while GLAN attains the best accuracy among them. These solvers are then integrated into a generalized labeled multi-Bernoulli (GLMB) tracker and evaluated on the WILDTRACK dataset, where GLAN yields tracking accuracy close to the Hungarian reference and comparable to recent DL-based trackers.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出并评估基于深度学习（DL）的线性分配问题（LAP）求解器，以替代多目标跟踪（MOT）系统中的经典匈牙利算法。研究了三种代表性神经模型，即卷积网络（CNN）、图神经网络（GNN）和基于图的线性分配网络（GLAN）。引入代价矩阵嵌入，使单个模型能够处理任意大小的代价矩阵，这符合MOT中目标数量随时间变化的要求，而无需为每种输入形状训练单独模型。大量仿真表明，该嵌入提高了神经求解器（即CNN和GNN）的准确性，而GLAN在其中取得最佳准确性。随后将这些求解器集成到广义标签多伯努利（GLMB）跟踪器中，并在WILDTRACK数据集上评估，其中GLAN产生的跟踪准确率接近匈牙利参考，并与近期基于DL的跟踪器相当。

items.title_en: A System 1 Decision Model for Medical Multiple-Choice Questions Built on Frozen Language Models
items.title_zh: 基于冻结语言模型的医学多项选择题System 1决策模型
items.abstract_en: A System 1 model answers a multiple-choice question in a single pass. A frozen language model turns the question and each option into vectors, two small, trained heads place them in a shared space, and the closest option wins. The design has been shown on agent decisions, but we are not aware of a study of how far it goes on exam questions that need medical knowledge, where the right option is often no more similar to the question than the wrong ones. We rebuilt the recipe from scratch for MedMCQA and trained only two projection heads and one temperature on top of frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B, Granite-4.2-3B and Qwen3-8B, using a contrastive loss with in-batch and hard negatives and a mask for repeated answers. With plain last-token vectors, both small encoders answer about one question in three correctly (33.1% and 33.0% on 3,842 held-out questions, where chance is 25.0%). Writing each text inside a one-word-summary prompt and lowering the learning rate of the heads raised this to 41.7% and 42.5% for the two small encoders and to 46.0% +-0.2 (three seeds) for Qwen3-8B. Shuffling the questions against the options returns accuracy to chance, so the heads do use the question. Flan-PaLM and Med-PaLM 2 report 57.6% and 72.3% on MedMCQA under a different protocol, so ours is a cheap, fast baseline and not a competitive system. We also say what our evidence cannot show: validation gains were about 1.7 to 2 times the test gains, and we could not separate the effect of reading several encoder layers from the other changes.
items.abstract_zh: System 1模型在一次前向传递中回答多项选择题。冻结语言模型将问题和每个选项转换为向量，两个小型且经过训练的头将它们放置到共享空间中，最接近的选项获胜。该设计已在智能体决策上得到展示，但我们尚未见到研究其在需要医学知识的考试题上能达到何种程度，在这些题中正确选项往往并不比错误选项与问题更相似。我们从头为MedMCQA重建该方案，仅在冻结的Qwen3.5-0.8B、Granite-4.2-3B和Qwen3-8B之上训练两个投影头和一个温度参数，使用带有批内负例和难负例的对比损失以及针对重复答案的掩码。使用普通的最后token向量时，两个小型编码器正确回答约三分之一的问题（在3,842个留出问题上分别为33.1%和33.0%，随机猜测为25.0%）。将每个文本写入一词摘要提示并降低头的学习率后，两个小型编码器分别提高到41.7%和42.5%，Qwen3-8B提高到46.0% +-0.2（三个随机种子）。将问题与选项打乱会使准确率回到随机水平，因此这些头确实使用了问题。Flan-PaLM和Med-PaLM 2在不同协议下报告了MedMCQA上的57.6%和72.3%，因此我们的方法是一个廉价、快速的基线，而不是一个有竞争力的系统。我们还说明了我们的证据无法表明的内容：验证集增益约为测试集增益的1.7至2倍，并且我们无法将读取多个编码器层的影响与其他变化区分开。

items.title_en: Technical Report of Mobile Manipulator Robot for Industrial Environments
items.title_zh: 面向工业环境的移动机械臂机器人技术报告
items.abstract_en: This paper presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot, developed at the Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Department of Electrical Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University. Hereafter, this platform is referred to as the @Work Robot. The robot targets industrial tasks, with an emphasis on improving efficiency in repetitive or hazardous work environments. It uses a 4-wheel Mecanum drive for omnidirectional movement and a 5-degree-of-freedom manipulator arm with a 3D-printed gripper for object handling and navigation. The electronics consist of custom PCB boards built around ESP32 microcontrollers, together with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX that handles high-level processing and real-time system control. On the software side, Hector SLAM provides mapping and localization, A* handles path planning, and YOLO performs real-time object detection. These modules draw on fused sensor data to deliver robust navigation and reliable collision avoidance. Overall, the system shows effective hardware-software integration, with consistent performance in autonomous navigation, object handling, and task execution in industrial-like settings.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍Auriga Robotics的移动机械臂机器人的设计与实现，该机器人由沙希德·贝赫什提大学电气工程系机器人与智能自动化实验室开发。下文将该平台称为@Work Robot。该机器人面向工业任务，重点提高重复性或危险工作环境中的效率。它使用四轮麦克纳姆驱动进行全向移动，并配备带3D打印夹爪的五自由度机械臂，用于物体处理和导航。电子部分包括围绕ESP32微控制器构建的定制PCB板，以及负责高层处理和实时系统控制的NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX。在软件方面，Hector SLAM提供建图与定位，A*处理路径规划，YOLO执行实时目标检测。这些模块利用融合的传感器数据来提供稳健的导航和可靠的避障。总体而言，该系统展示了有效的软硬件集成，在类似工业环境中的自主导航、物体处理和任务执行方面具有一致性能。

items.title_en: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
items.title_zh: Game2Player：通过环境-玩家协同开发扩展视觉智能体的游戏玩法经验
items.abstract_en: Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, collecting human gameplay is costly, and learning from gameplay videos requires inferring missing actions. Existing datasets also cover a limited range of games, often without explicit tasks or verifiable outcomes. To address these gaps, we introduce Game2Player, a framework that co-develops game environments and players to collect diverse and verifiable gameplay experience at scale. In the Game2Player loop, a Builder agent adapts existing web games, exposes their internal state, and defines tasks with state-based progress measures and success checks. A Coding Player and a VLM Player then attempt the tasks and report problems to the Builder for repair, so that play serves as both environment validation and training data collection. With Game2Player, we build 568 verified web games with 3,436 tasks, collect 15.7K trajectories (307 hours of gameplay), and hold out 50 games as the benchmark PlayerBench. To evaluate the collected experience as training data, we train VLM agents with progress-weighted SFT, assigning greater weight to steps that advance task progress. Game2Player-9B improves progress from 14.3% to 31.2% on PlayerBench and from 30.0% to 53.1% on the external GameWorld benchmark. More broadly, our work suggests a path for visual agents to scale their gameplay experience by building, verifying, and learning from existing game worlds.
items.abstract_zh: 游戏是视觉智能体的丰富测试平台，要求感知、长时程规划和精确控制。然而，收集人类游戏玩法成本高昂，而从游戏视频中学习需要推断缺失的动作。现有数据集覆盖的游戏范围也有限，往往没有明确任务或可验证的结果。为弥补这些空白，我们提出 Game2Player，一个协同开发游戏环境和玩家的框架，以规模化收集多样且可验证的游戏玩法经验。在 Game2Player 循环中，Builder 智能体改编现有网页游戏，暴露其内部状态，并定义带有基于状态的进度度量和成功检查的任务。随后 Coding Player 和 VLM Player 尝试这些任务，并向 Builder 报告问题以便修复，从而使游玩既作为环境验证，也作为训练数据收集。借助 Game2Player，我们构建了 568 个经过验证的网页游戏，包含 3,436 个任务，收集了 15.7K 条轨迹（307 小时游戏玩法），并留出 50 个游戏作为基准 PlayerBench。为评估所收集经验作为训练数据的效果，我们使用进度加权 SFT 训练 VLM 智能体，对推进任务进度的步骤赋予更大权重。Game2Player-9B 在 PlayerBench 上将进度从 14.3% 提升至 31.2%，在外部 GameWorld 基准上从 30.0% 提升至 53.1%。更广泛地说，我们的工作为视觉智能体指明了一条通过构建、验证并从现有游戏世界学习来扩展其游戏玩法经验的路径。

items.title_en: Hybrid Video and Instance Segmentation for Surgical Scene Understanding in Robotic Mitral Valve Surgery
items.title_zh: 用于机器人二尖瓣手术中手术场景理解的混合视频与实例分割
items.abstract_en: Objective: Artificial intelligence-based surgical scene segmentation is fundamental to surgical scene understanding. However, the optimal segmentation strategy for robotic cardiac surgery remains unknown. We developed and evaluated a hybrid segmentation framework combining Mask R- CNN and Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) for surgical scene recognition during the entry phase of robotic mitral valve surgery. Methods: Intraoperative videos from ten robotic mitral valve operations performed at two institutions were analyzed. Seven anatomical structures and surgical object classes (ascending aorta, diaphragm, lung, pericardium, right atrium, robotic arms, and sutures) were manually annotated from 2172 image frames. We created three patient-level training, validation, and test splits after ruling out any split where an object class was completely missing from validation or test. Three segmentation approaches were compared: Mask R-CNN, Mask R-CNN-prompted SAM2 for all seven classes, and a hybrid late-fusion model combining SAM2 for anatomical structures and Mask R-CNN for robotic arms and sutures. Model performance was assessed using pixel accuracy, mean intersection over union (IoU), and Dice score. Results: Across the three patient-level splits, the hybrid late-fusion model achieved the highest average overall segmentation performance, with pixel accuracy of 0.79-0.91, mean IoU of 0.64-0.74, and mean Dice of 0.76-0.84. At the object level, late-fusion Dice scores across the three splits were 0.86-0.96 for aorta, 0.38-0.90 for diaphragm, 0.77-0.92 for lung, 0.48-0.77 for pericardium, 0.68- 0.90 for right atrium, 0.95-0.97 for robotic arms, and 0.66-0.76 for sutures. Mask R-CNN- prompted SAM2 outperformed Mask R-CNN for the aorta in all three splits and for the lung, pericardium, diaphragm, and right atrium in two of three splits, whereas Mask R-CNN was more reliable for sutures, including Dice scores of 0.76 vs 0.21 and 0.66 vs 0.53 in Splits 2 and 3. By combining prompted SAM2 for anatomy with Mask R-CNN for robotic arms and sutures, late fusion achieved the highest mean Dice in two of three splits (0.84 and 0.76) and the highest mean Dice averaged across all three splits; all-object SAM2 propagation performed slightly better in the remaining split (0.81 vs 0.80). Conclusions: A hybrid segmentation framework combining SAM2 and Mask R-CNN achieved the highest overall segmentation performance in two of three patient-level splits and performed comparably to the best-performing model in the remaining split. These findings suggest that object-specific hybrid segmentation strategies may improve surgical scene segmentation during robotic mitral valve surgery.
items.abstract_zh: 目的：基于人工智能的手术场景分割是手术场景理解的基础。然而，机器人心脏手术的最佳分割策略仍未知。我们开发并评估了一个混合分割框架，结合 Mask R-CNN 和 Segment Anything Model 2（SAM2），用于机器人二尖瓣手术进入阶段的手术场景识别。方法：分析来自两家机构实施的十例机器人二尖瓣手术的术中视频。从 2172 个图像帧中手动标注了七类解剖结构和手术物体类别（升主动脉、膈肌、肺、心包、右心房、机械臂和缝线）。在排除验证集或测试集中某个物体类别完全缺失的任何划分后，我们创建了三个患者级训练、验证和测试划分。比较了三种分割方法：Mask R-CNN、对所有七类使用 Mask R-CNN 提示的 SAM2，以及结合 SAM2 用于解剖结构和 Mask R-CNN 用于机械臂和缝线的混合晚期融合模型。使用像素准确率、平均交并比（IoU）和 Dice 分数评估模型性能。结果：在三个患者级划分中，混合晚期融合模型取得最高的平均总体分割性能，像素准确率为 0.79-0.91，平均 IoU 为 0.64-0.74，平均 Dice 为 0.76-0.84。在物体层面，三个划分中晚期融合的 Dice 分数为：主动脉 0.86-0.96，膈肌 0.38-0.90，肺 0.77-0.92，心包 0.48-0.77，右心房 0.68-0.90，机械臂 0.95-0.97，缝线 0.66-0.76。Mask R-CNN 提示的 SAM2 在三个划分中主动脉上均优于 Mask R-CNN，并在三个划分中的两个里对肺、心包、膈肌和右心房优于 Mask R-CNN，而 Mask R-CNN 对缝线更可靠，包括在划分 2 和 3 中 Dice 分数分别为 0.76 对 0.21 和 0.66 对 0.53。通过将提示 SAM2 用于解剖结构与 Mask R-CNN 用于机械臂和缝线相结合，晚期融合在三个划分中的两个里取得最高平均 Dice（0.84 和 0.76），并在所有三个划分的平均中取得最高平均 Dice；全物体 SAM2 传播在剩余划分中略好（0.81 对 0.80）。结论：结合 SAM2 和 Mask R-CNN 的混合分割框架在三个患者级划分中的两个里取得最高总体分割性能，并在剩余划分中与表现最佳的模型相当。这些发现表明，物体特定的混合分割策略可能改善机器人二尖瓣手术中的手术场景分割。

items.title_en: Strong Epsilon-Near-Zero Confinement and Interface-Controlled Dynamics in Inverse-Designed Transparent Conducting Oxide Cavities
items.title_zh: 逆设计透明导电氧化物腔中的强 ε-近零约束与界面控制动力学
items.abstract_en: Achieving optical modulation that is both strong and ultrafast remains a central challenge in time-varying photonics. Here, we theoretically demonstrate that combining inverse-designed cavities that utilize transparent conducting oxides (TCOs) operating at the epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) point with boundaries that support carrier transport can meet this requirement. This is achieved by leveraging ENZ-enhanced optical absorption and electron heating with interface-engineered carrier relaxation. A multilayer inverse-design framework, combined with a structural disorder-aware correction loop, is developed to preserve robust resonant absorption in ultrathin TCO films under realistic material disorder. Relative to conventional TCO cavity geometries, the inverse-designed structures exhibit stronger light confinement, greater electron temperature modulation, and markedly faster recovery. Beyond cavity design, interfacial barrier engineering and adjacent-layer doping emerge as effective degrees of freedom for co-designing spectral and temporal dynamics. Furthermore, our theoretical framework shows that the inverse-designed cavity supports richer oscillatory transmittance dynamics on the few-optical-cycle timescale compared to its single-film counterpart, with interfacial control enabling further temporal compression. The combined control of optical confinement and interfacial dynamics establishes inverse-designed TCO cavities as a viable platform for time-varying photonic media capable of supporting strong and ultrafast optical responses.
items.abstract_zh: 实现既强又超快的光学调制仍然是时变光子学的核心挑战。在此，我们从理论上证明，将工作在 epsilon-近零（ENZ）点的透明导电氧化物（TCO）逆设计腔与支持载流子输运的边界相结合，可以满足这一要求。这是通过利用 ENZ 增强的光吸收和电子加热以及界面工程化的载流子弛豫来实现的。我们开发了一个多层逆设计框架，并结合结构无序感知校正环路，以在现实材料无序下保持超薄 TCO 薄膜中稳健的共振吸收。相对于传统 TCO 腔几何结构，逆设计结构表现出更强的光约束、更大的电子温度调制以及显著更快的恢复。除腔设计之外，界面势垒工程和相邻层掺杂成为协同设计光谱与时间动力学的有效自由度。此外，我们的理论框架表明，与单薄膜对应结构相比，逆设计腔在少光学周期时间尺度上支持更丰富的振荡透射动力学，而界面控制可实现进一步的时间压缩。对光约束和界面动力学的联合控制，使逆设计 TCO 腔成为时变光子介质的可行平台，能够支持强且超快的光学响应。

items.title_en: Learning with Unlearning: Synaptic Role Partitioning for Simultaneous Continual Learning and Machine Unlearning
items.title_zh: Learning with Unlearning：用于同时持续学习与机器遗忘的突触角色划分
items.abstract_en: Continual Learning (CL) asks a model to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what it already knows. Machine Unlearning (MU) asks it to destroy specific knowledge without damaging the rest. The challenge is integrating them in the same system; the two objectives pull on the same weights, and an edit made for one harms the other. To address this, we propose Learning with Unlearning (LwU), a unified framework that resolves the conflict where it occurs: at the individual synapse. LwU scores every weight twice, once against the data to keep and once against the data to delete, and partitions the network into four zones with separate update rules. Weights that only require retention are frozen. Weights that only require deletion are cleared and returned to the network as free capacity. Contested weights take a gradient-ascent step projected orthogonally to the retention gradient. The remaining capacity learns the incoming task by a privileged teacher via self-distillation. Deletion is served post hoc, and no retraining is required. Across both CL and MU jobs, LwU outperforms or matches the strongest baseline. Its real-world practicality has been demonstrated on the Physical Artificial Intelligence (PAI) dataset we conducted. Additionally, in the image generation task and in removing dangerous content, it outperformed the closest baseline, as shown in Fig.1.
items.abstract_zh: 持续学习（CL）要求模型获得新知识而不遗忘已学知识。机器遗忘（MU）要求模型销毁特定知识而不损害其余知识。挑战在于将二者集成到同一系统中；两个目标作用于相同权重，为其中一个目标所做的编辑会损害另一个。为解决此问题，我们提出 Learning with Unlearning（LwU），一个在冲突发生处——单个突触——解决冲突的统一框架。LwU 对每个权重进行两次评分，一次针对需要保留的数据，一次针对需要删除的数据，并将网络划分为四个具有独立更新规则的区域。仅需要保留的权重被冻结。仅需要删除的权重被清除，并作为空闲容量返回网络。存在争议的权重采取一个投影到保留梯度正交方向的梯度上升步骤。剩余容量通过特权教师以自蒸馏方式学习传入任务。删除是事后完成的，且无需重新训练。在 CL 和 MU 两类任务中，LwU 优于或匹配最强基线。其实际可行性已在我们构建的 Physical Artificial Intelligence（PAI）数据集上得到证明。此外，如图 1 所示，在图像生成任务和移除危险内容方面，它优于最接近的基线。

items.title_en: From Arraignment to Resolution: Transformer Models of Court Cases
items.title_zh: 从传讯到裁决：法院案件的 Transformer 模型
items.abstract_en: The criminal legal system is composed of many complex decision points, such as which charges are pursued, how bond is determined, plea deal negotiations, and sentencing. Given the profound impact of such decisions, there is a growing need to increase the transparency within this system. While prior machine learning approaches have focused on modeling single decisions (e.g., recidivism), this paper proposes a transformer-based time series model to forecast the outcome of the next proceeding in a case (e.g., charges accepted, bond set, plea deal made, etc.). By modeling a case as an event sequence, we enable a more nuanced analysis to support better oversight and understanding of decision making. We conduct an empirical analysis of thousands of cases using a newly constructed dataset derived from publicly available court records of a mid-sized U.S. city. We fit models that combine textual data from clerk notes with structured information about the defendant, prior charges, and courtroom. Our transformer model achieves $.57$ micro-F1 on a 20-class multi-label task, a significant improvement over several baselines and comparable to a GRU trained on the same input. We demonstrate how the model can be used to provide insights into decision-making and help court observers identify emerging issues within the jurisdiction studied.
items.abstract_zh: 刑事司法系统由许多复杂决策点组成，例如追究哪些指控、如何确定保释金、认罪协议谈判以及量刑。鉴于此类决策的深远影响，提高该系统的透明度需求日益增长。以往机器学习方法主要对单一决策（如累犯）建模，而本文提出一种基于 Transformer 的时间序列模型，用于预测案件中下一次程序的结果（例如指控被接受、保释金设定、达成认罪协议等）。通过将案件建模为事件序列，我们能够进行更细致的分析，以支持更好的监督和对决策的理解。我们使用一个根据美国一座中型城市公开法院记录新构建的数据集，对数千起案件进行了实证分析。我们拟合的模型结合了书记员笔记中的文本数据与关于被告、既往指控和法庭的结构化信息。我们的 Transformer 模型在一个 20 类多标签任务上达到 0.57 的微 F1，较多个基线有显著提升，并与在相同输入上训练的 GRU 相当。我们展示了该模型如何用于提供对决策的洞察，并帮助法庭观察者识别所研究司法管辖区内新出现的问题。

items.title_en: Autonomous Track Racing with a Commercially Available Humanoid: System Design and Real-World Deployment
items.title_zh: 使用市售人形机器人进行自主赛道竞速：系统设计与真实世界部署
items.abstract_en: Learning-based methods now let humanoids run robustly, and they have begun to compete in athletic events. Yet few reports describe a complete autonomous humanoid running system in an actual race, where the robot must follow a lane at a new venue, pace itself within hardware limits, and finish without intervention. We report such a system deployed on the Unitree G1, a commercially available general-purpose humanoid, in the 100 m, 400 m, and 1500 m events of the World Humanoid Robot Games 2026. The system integrates vision-based lane perception, path tracking, and a running policy trained by reinforcement learning with a human motion prior. To address the challenges of humanoid running, we stabilize head-camera images against body motion and use IMU-assisted leg odometry to bridge flight phases. To manage motor heating, we penalize hip-pitch torque during training, add heat-dissipation plates, and apply temperature-based speed limiting with event-specific pacing. The robot placed 13th of 74 in the 100 m, 10th of 44 in the 400 m first round before falling in the semifinal, and seventh of 35 in the 1500 m. In this deployment, thermal margin set the pace in every event, and the semifinal fall followed a lane-detection error.
items.abstract_zh: 基于学习的方法现在使人形机器人能够稳健奔跑，它们已经开始参加体育赛事。然而，很少有报告描述一个完整的自主人形机器人奔跑系统在实际比赛中的情况，其中机器人必须在新场地沿跑道行进，在硬件限制内控制配速，并在无干预情况下完成比赛。我们报告了在 Unitree G1（一款市售通用人形机器人）上部署的这样一个系统，参加 2026 年世界人形机器人运动会（World Humanoid Robot Games 2026）的 100 米、400 米和 1500 米项目。该系统集成了基于视觉的跑道感知、路径跟踪，以及由强化学习和人类运动先验训练的奔跑策略。为应对人形机器人奔跑的挑战，我们稳定头部相机图像以抵抗身体运动，并使用 IMU 辅助的腿部里程计来衔接腾空阶段。为管理电机发热，我们在训练中惩罚髋关节俯仰力矩，添加散热板，并应用基于温度的速度限制和针对各项目的配速策略。该机器人在 100 米中位列 74 名中的第 13 名，在 400 米第一轮中位列 44 名中的第 10 名，随后在半决赛中摔倒，在 1500 米中位列 35 名中的第 7 名。在此次部署中，热裕度决定了每个项目的配速，半决赛摔倒发生在一次车道检测错误之后。

items.title_en: PrismRestore: A Compact Restoration Toolbox for Agentic Image Restoration
items.title_zh: PrismRestore：面向智能体图像复原的紧凑型复原工具箱
items.abstract_en: Agentic image restoration composes operations to handle mixed degradations, yet its toolbox often requires storing multiple restoration networks. We propose PrismRestore, which constructs a compact bank of callable restoration actions from a single frozen all-in-one model. Our approach builds on task-dependent yet overlapping channel responses in the shared model. An offline task-prior search uses activation and gradient statistics to group channels with similar response profiles, then searches task-specific modulation coefficients over non-representative channels while leaving representative channels unmodulated. The resulting prior bank enables explicit action selection and composition without additional restoration backbones or task-specific adapter modules. A state-conditioned policy learns to compose these actions using Group Relative Policy Optimization. Its objective separately normalizes fidelity and perceptual feedback within groups of trajectories sampled for the same input, and combines terminal evaluation with return-to-go derived from stepwise quality changes. Experiments on synthetic composite-degradation and real-world multi-task benchmarks show improvements over the evaluated all-in-one baselines and restoration quality competitive with multi-model agents. PrismRestore achieves these results with a single restoration backbone and faster inference than the evaluated agentic baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 智能体图像复原通过组合操作来处理混合退化，但其工具箱通常需要存储多个复原网络。我们提出 PrismRestore，它从单个冻结的一体化模型中构建一个紧凑的可调用复原动作库。我们的方法基于共享模型中任务相关但相互重叠的通道响应。离线任务先验搜索利用激活和梯度统计量对具有相似响应特征的通道进行分组，然后在非代表性通道上搜索任务特定的调制系数，同时保持代表性通道不调制。所得的先验库无需额外的复原骨干网络或任务特定适配器模块即可实现显式的动作选择与组合。一个状态条件策略使用组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization）学习组合这些动作。其目标在同一输入采样的轨迹组内分别归一化保真度和感知反馈，并将终端评估与由逐步质量变化推导的剩余回报（return-to-go）相结合。在合成复合退化和真实世界多任务基准上的实验表明，相较于所评估的一体化基线有所提升，且复原质量与多模型智能体相当。PrismRestore 仅用一个复原骨干网络即可实现这些结果，并且推理速度比所评估的智能体基线更快。

items.title_en: MtbAIM: AI/ML-guided endpoint-specific prediction of small-molecule activity across drug-susceptible and drug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis
items.title_zh: MtbAIM：AI/ML 引导的跨药物敏感与耐药结核分枝杆菌小分子活性终点特异性预测
items.abstract_en: The emergence of drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (M.tb) presents a major challenge to drug discovery, as compounds active against drug-susceptible (DS) isolates may not retain comparable inhibitory activity against drug-resistant (DR) isolates. Here, we developed an AI/ML workflow to independently prioritize small molecules separately against DS and DR isolates of M.tb and predict MIC, MIC90, and MIC99 as distinct quantitative endpoints. Following curation of data retrieved from the ChEMBL repository, molecular-activity datasets comprised 25,645 and 3,749 compounds tested against whole cell DS and DR isolates respectively. Molecular representations were generated using RDKit descriptors and Morgan fingerprints, along with embeddings from ChemBERTa, MolCLR, and Uni-Mol, and evaluated for binary activity classification and endpoint-specific regression. The best-performing DS classifier combined RDKit/Morgan features with ExtraTrees (balanced accuracy 0.782; AUROC 0.864; AUPRC 0.870), while histogram gradient boosting using the same features performed best for DR classification (balanced accuracy 0.762; AUROC 0.836; AUPRC 0.880). Similarly, RDKit/Morgan features combined with tree-based regressors achieved the best overall performance across all six DS/DR regression endpoints, with pooled out-of-fold RMSE values ranging from 0.604 to 0.784 pMIC units. To facilitate broader application, we developed MtbAIM (https://github.com/jasdeep002/MtbAIM), a Google Colab-based prediction platform that enables users to assess and prioritize small molecules against DS and DR isolates of M.tb.
items.abstract_zh: 结核分枝杆菌（M.tb）耐药性的出现对药物发现构成重大挑战，因为对药物敏感（DS）分离株有活性的化合物可能对耐药（DR）分离株不能保持相当的抑制活性。在此，我们开发了一个 AI/ML 工作流程，分别针对 M.tb 的 DS 和 DR 分离株独立地优先排序小分子，并将 MIC、MIC90 和 MIC99 作为不同的定量终点进行预测。在对从 ChEMBL 存储库检索的数据进行整理后，分子-活性数据集分别包含针对全细胞 DS 和 DR 分离株测试的 25,645 和 3,749 个化合物。分子表示使用 RDKit 描述符和 Morgan 指纹，以及来自 ChemBERTa、MolCLR 和 Uni-Mol 的嵌入生成，并针对二元活性分类和终点特异性回归进行评估。表现最佳的 DS 分类器将 RDKit/Morgan 特征与 ExtraTrees 结合（平衡准确率 0.782；AUROC 0.864；AUPRC 0.870），而使用相同特征的直方图梯度提升在 DR 分类中表现最佳（平衡准确率 0.762；AUROC 0.836；AUPRC 0.880）。同样，RDKit/Morgan 特征与基于树的回归器结合在所有六个 DS/DR 回归终点上取得了最佳总体性能，汇总的折外 RMSE 值范围为 0.604 至 0.784 pMIC 单位。为促进更广泛应用，我们开发了 MtbAIM（https://github.com/jasdeep002/MtbAIM），一个基于 Google Colab 的预测平台，使用户能够评估和优先排序针对 M.tb 的 DS 和 DR 分离株的小分子。

items.title_en: Dressed-State Quantum Information Processing Using a Multilayer Ion Trap Chip with an Integrated Radio Frequency Resonator
items.title_zh: 使用集成射频谐振器的多层离子阱芯片进行缀饰态量子信息处理
items.abstract_en: We present the experimental preparation of a radio frequency (RF)-dressed-state qubit, the coherent operation of a single RF-dressed qubit, and the selective readout of RF-dressed hyperfine states of $^{171}$Yb${^+}$ ions trapped using a novel microstructured ion trap chip. We demonstrate the individual addressing of RF-dressed-state qubits in a two-ion Coulomb crystal. To this end, we developed, manufactured, and characterized a trap chip specifcally designed for quantum information processing with RF-dressed-state qubits. The chip consists of multiple layers, one of which includes an integrated resonator that creates a gradient of the RF magnetic field amplitude along the axis of a linear ion crystal. This RF gradient enables the individual addressing of dressed qubit states as well as their coupling. We characterize the ion trap chip experimentally using the hyperfine states of the electronic ground state of laser cooled $^{171}$Yb${^+}$ ions and by applying a single, global, modulated RF field oscillating near 12.6 GHz that drives dressed-state resonances. We present a microfabricated multilayer ion trap chip specifically designed for quantum information processing based on dressed-state qubits. This ion trap chip consists of multiple layers, one of which includes an integrated radio frequency (RF) resonator, creating a gradient of the RF magnetic field amplitude that allows for individual qubit addressing and qubit-qubit coupling. We experimentally characterize this ion trap chip demonstrating dressed-qubit state preparation, coherent single dressed-qubit operation, and dressed-state-selective read-out using hyperfine states of the electronic ground state of $^{171}$Yb${^+}$. For this purpose, a global modulated RF driving field oscillating near 12.6 GHz is applied to the ions. In addition, we demonstrate individual addressing of dressed-state qubits in a two-ion Coulomb crystal.
items.abstract_zh: 我们展示了射频（RF）缀饰态量子比特的实验制备、单个 RF 缀饰量子比特的相干操作，以及使用新型微结构离子阱芯片捕获的 $^{171}$Yb${^+}$ 离子 RF 缀饰超精细态的选择性读出。我们演示了在两离子库仑晶体中对 RF 缀饰态量子比特的单独寻址。为此，我们开发、制造并表征了一种专为使用 RF 缀饰态量子比特进行量子信息处理而设计的阱芯片。该芯片由多层组成，其中一层包含集成谐振器，该谐振器沿线性离子晶体轴产生 RF 磁场幅度的梯度。这种 RF 梯度使得缀饰量子比特态的单独寻址及其耦合成为可能。我们利用激光冷却的 $^{171}$Yb${^+}$ 离子电子基态的超精细态，并通过施加一个在 12.6 GHz 附近振荡、驱动缀饰态共振的单一全局调制 RF 场，对离子阱芯片进行了实验表征。我们提出了一种专门设计用于基于缀饰态量子比特的量子信息处理的微制造多层离子阱芯片。该离子阱芯片由多层组成，其中一层包含集成射频（RF）谐振器，产生 RF 磁场幅度的梯度，从而允许单独的量子比特寻址和量子比特-量子比特耦合。我们通过实验表征了该离子阱芯片，展示了使用 $^{171}$Yb${^+}$ 电子基态的超精细态进行缀饰量子比特态制备、相干单缀饰量子比特操作和缀饰态选择性读出。为此，向离子施加一个在 12.6 GHz 附近振荡的全局调制 RF 驱动场。此外，我们演示了在两离子库仑晶体中缀饰态量子比特的单独寻址。
